items.title_zh: 威马汽车公众号喊话“B 能汽车”讨薪，消息称 App 再次无法使用
items.title_en: WM Motor's WeChat Account Demands Unpaid Wages From 'B-Neng Auto'; Xiaowei App Reportedly Unusable Again
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，威马汽车官方微信公众号号今日发文“ 第一天：B 能汽车，请发我们工资 ”，但不久后便删除了文章。 据蓝鲸新闻报道，威马汽车官方 App“小威随行 App”在苹果商店已无法搜索到。从今年 6 月底开始，有车主反映 小威随行 App 无法使用 。 2025 年 9 月，威马汽车发布《 关于“新威马汽车”重组情况的说明 》，根据 2025 年 4 月 3 日法院裁定批准的重整计划， 深圳翔飞汽车销售有限公司 已接管威马四公司，正在全力以赴推动威马 EX5 和 E5 车型在温州基地快速恢复量产。 新威马制定了分三步走的 2025~2030 经营发展规划： 复兴阶段（2025~2026）：2025 年 9 月复产 EX5 / E.5 车型，确保年产销 1 万台，争取实现产销 2 万辆; 同时海外破局，布局泰国 KD 工厂，开拓东南亚及中东市场。2026 年量产 10 万台。 发展阶段（2027~2028）：年销量跃升 25 → 40 万台高阶辅助驾驶车型量产，AI 赋能研发、生产、营销全链条，启动 IPO 筹备。 跨越阶段（2029~2030）：2030 年产量挑战 100 万台营收 1200 亿，构造智慧出行生态圈，成为行业新标杆。 据IT之家 2025 年 11 月报道， 小威随行 App 重新上线 iOS 和安卓平台 ，威马汽车团队宣布成功恢复了小威随…
items.summary_en: WM Motor's official WeChat account posted a message demanding unpaid wages from 'B-Neng Auto' before deleting it. Reports say the company's Xiaowei Suixing app can no longer be found on the Apple Store, and owners have complained about outages since late June. The incident follows WM Motor's restructuring, under which Shenzhen Xiangfei took over its four entities and is pushing to resume EX5 and E5 production in Wenzhou.
items.why_zh: 公众号公开讨薪与 App 再度失灵，显示威马重组复产后仍面临资金与运营困境。
items.why_en: A public wage demand and another app outage suggest WM Motor still faces funding and operational troubles after its restructuring.

items.title_zh: 豆包工作上线新功能，支持跨AI产品一键导入已有配置
items.title_en: Doubao Work Adds One-Click Import of Configurations Across AI Products
items.summary_zh: 豆包工作上线新功能，支持跨AI产品一键导入已有配置 CSDN
items.summary_en: Doubao Work has rolled out a feature that lets users import existing configurations from other AI products with one click, lowering the barrier to switching between AI assistants. Details on which platforms are supported were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 跨产品配置迁移可直接降低用户更换 AI 工具的成本，是争夺存量用户的手段。
items.why_en: Cross-product configuration migration cuts the cost of switching AI tools, a key way to win existing users.

items.summary_en: Doubao Work introduced several AI collaboration features, including cross-platform data migration, a conversation summary sidebar and context continuity. The updates aim to make long conversations and multi-turn AI workflows smoother, though detailed specifications were not released.
items.why_zh: 围绕上下文与数据迁移打磨体验，反映 AI 办公助手竞争正从模型能力转向工作流黏性。
items.why_en: Improving context and data migration shows AI office assistants now compete on workflow stickiness rather than model capability alone.

items.title_zh: Rust 编写：开发者挑战 Adobe 后再挑战微软，Office 三件套替代品上线
items.title_en: Developer Builds Rust and Claude AI-Powered Office Alternatives After Taking On Adobe
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 NeoWin 昨日（10 月 13 日）发布博文，报道称 在推出 ArtCraft 挑战 Adobe 的 Creative Suite 套件 后， 开发者兰登 · 托马斯（Brandon Thomas）调用 Claude AI 模型，又向微软 Office 发起挑战。 托马斯昨日发布 WordCraft、GridCraft 和 DeckCraft，分别定位为 Microsoft Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 的免费替代品，三款应用均采用 Rust 语言编写，并由 Claude AI 辅助编码打造。 在兼容平台上，WordCraft、GridCraft 和 DeckCraft 兼容 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 原生版本，同时支持 BSD 系统，并通过 WebAssembly 提供浏览器版本。 WordCraft 支持 Ribbon 界面、文档样式、表格、修订、批注、拼写和语法检查以及邮件合并。该应用可打开和保存 DOCX 文件，兼容 ODT、RTF、HTML、Markdown 和纯文本，并能导出 PDF。 GridCraft 内置超过 500 个函数的公式引擎，支持动态数组、条件格式、图表、表格和 PivotTables。其原生格式为 XLSX，兼容 CSV 和 TSV，也能导入旧版 XLS 工作簿，但尚未…
items.summary_en: Developer Brandon Thomas has followed his Adobe-challenging ArtCraft with WordCraft, GridCraft and DeckCraft, free alternatives to Word, Excel and PowerPoint written in Rust with Claude AI's help. They run natively on Windows, macOS, Linux and BSD, with browser versions via WebAssembly, and support formats including DOCX, XLSX and PDF export.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 辅助编码推动开源办公软件追赶微软生态的又一实例，展示了大模型对个人开发者的生产力放大效应。
items.why_en: It is another example of AI-assisted coding letting a solo developer challenge Microsoft's office suite, showing how LLMs amplify individual productivity.

items.title_zh: SEMI 预测：全球 300mm 晶圆厂设备投资 2029 年将达 2270 亿美元
items.title_en: SEMI Forecasts Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending to Reach $227 Billion by 2029
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，SEMI（国际半导体产业协会）当地时间昨日在 SEMICON West 2026 展览会上发布最新预测。 该机构认为全球 300mm（12 英寸）前端晶圆厂设备支出今年可达 1,490 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 9,990.49 亿元人民币） ，同比大增 31%；未来数年则将维持超一成增幅， 到 2029 年达 2,270 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.52 万亿元人民币） 。 ▲ 图源：SEMI 强劲的设备支出由大规模的产能建设支持 。机构认为今年全球有 26 个新的 12 英寸晶圆厂产线项目开工，而这一数目在 2027 年将是 18 条；今年的 12 英寸产线投运数量是 13 条，明年则会是 23 条。 全球 12 英寸晶圆厂的建设支出在今年增长 23% 至 475 亿美元，明后年则将分别达到 633 亿美元和 684 亿美元。 SEMI 总裁兼首席执行官 Ajit Manocha 表示： 半导体需求的增长正日益转化为全球半导体行业实体的产能扩张。 最新展望显示，设备投资正在增强，且有大量晶圆厂项目即将投产。这一扩张将提供必要的制造基础，以支持 AI、HPC 以及广泛的下一代半导体应用。 参考 U.S . Construction Pipeline Expands Amid Strong Global 300mm Investment
items.summary_en: SEMI forecasts global 300mm front-end fab equipment spending will hit $149 billion this year, up 31% year over year, and reach $227 billion by 2029. The boom is backed by large-scale capacity construction, with 26 new 300mm fab line projects starting this year. SEMI CEO Ajit Manocha said the expansion provides the manufacturing base for AI, HPC and next-generation semiconductor applications.
items.why_zh: 设备支出与晶圆厂建设的走向，是判断 AI 与 HPC 芯片产能供给能否跟上下游需求的关键先行指标。
items.why_en: Fab equipment spending and construction are leading indicators of whether chip capacity can keep pace with AI and HPC demand.

items.title_zh: ACED-Bench：评估 LLM 智能体如何获取并依据因果证据行动
items.title_en: ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出 ACED-BENCH（Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark），一个以神经-符号方式构建的基准，用于评估大模型智能体能否像科研助手那样“调查一个系统”，而不仅仅是回答一个提示。该基准要求智能体自行选择实验、解读有限证据并做出因果决策，同时保证环境在重复观测与干预之间保持一致，并保留客观的真值标准。作者指出，现有评测缺乏能够同时满足上述条件的可靠方式，而这正是科学场景中智能体能力的关键缺口。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement…
items.why_zh: 如果 LLM 要充当科研助手，就必须具备主动实验与因果推断能力，该基准为这类能力提供了更贴近真实科学流程的评测标准。
items.why_en: If LLMs are to serve as scientific assistants, they must design experiments and reason causally; this benchmark offers a more realistic way to measure that capability.

items.title_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV：面向泛血管介入研究的验证器约束递归改进协议
items.title_en: ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research
items.summary_zh: ScienceBuddy-PV 将 ScienceBuddy 的“递归中的递归”设计迁移到泛血管介入研究领域，依靠结构化证据账本、器械-血管本体、弃权契约以及保留的失败库来组织流程，并规定了递归式工具链优化与包含强化学习在内的外层模型学习机制——但这些环节在本文中仅作规格说明，并未实际执行。研究采用 ARCADE 语法与狭窄（stenosis）两类任务，每类各 1000 张训练、200 张验证与 300 张测试图像，审计对象是系统中的固定组件而非完整智能体系统。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convoluti…
items.why_zh: 它展示了如何用验证器、证据账本与弃权机制来约束高风险医疗研究中的智能体流程，同时坦承哪些环节尚未真正运行，为科学 AI 的可审计性提供了参考。
items.why_en: It shows how verifiers, evidence ledgers and abstention contracts can govern agents in high-stakes medical research—and is candid about which parts remain unimplemented—offering a model for auditable science AI.

items.title_zh: RASSG：面向流式工具执行的“修复感知语义存活门控”
items.title_en: RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution
items.summary_zh: 流式语音助手常在用户尚未说完时就启动工具，以重叠执行来缩短等待时间，但用户随后的自我纠正可能让看似稳定的参数失效，导致“陈旧执行”——即使最终调用被修正，其不可逆影响依然存在。为此作者提出 Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating（RASSG），在流式语音过程中同时控制工具的启动与取消：例如当连续三次语音识别结果的关键内容一致时才触发工具调用，并在检测到修复行为时及时撤销。该机制旨在兼顾低延迟与执行安全，减少因过早执行造成的不可逆后果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical n…
items.why_zh: 语音助手提前执行工具能降低延迟，却可能带来无法撤销的副作用；RASSG 试图在响应速度与执行安全之间建立可操作的平衡机制。
items.why_en: Early tool execution in voice assistants cuts latency but risks irreversible side effects; RASSG offers a concrete mechanism to balance responsiveness with execution safety.

items.title_zh: 减少循环次数会让循环深度语言模型丧失拒答行为
items.title_en: Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
items.summary_zh: 循环深度语言模型会在推理时把同一组权重连续复用多次，这个重复次数（称为 loops）由部署时决定而非训练时固定，减少循环能带来更低成本与更快速度，因此实际部署中可能被采用。研究发现，减少循环次数会削弱模型的安全性，且这种安全性的损失比其他任何被测指标的下滑都更明显。作者测试了四个已发布的 Ouro 检查点和 Huginn-0125：Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 在训练深度的一半时仍能解出 0.692 的 GSM8K 数学题，说明能力保留与安全退化并不同步。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems,…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了推理成本优化与模型安全之间的隐性权衡：为省钱而减少循环，可能以远超其他能力损失的幅度破坏模型的拒答行为。
items.why_en: It exposes a hidden trade-off between inference-cost optimization and safety: trimming loops to save compute can break refusal behaviour far more than it degrades other measured abilities.

items.title_zh: LURE：带阶段标注的在线诱拐对话合成语料库
items.title_en: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
items.summary_zh: 研究未成年人网络诱拐（grooming）的进展过程并开发早期预警工具，需要带阶段标注的对话数据。然而目前唯一公开可用的来源——Perverted-Justice 存档（其中一部分用 ChatCoder 编码）——规模小、内容陈旧且已停止更新。为此作者提出 LURE：一个由检索增强流水线在机构自建硬件上生成的诱拐者-受害者对话合成语料库，该流水线使用一个公开可得的 80 亿参数、已去除拒答行为（refusal-ablated）的语言模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15908v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus…
items.why_zh: 它用合成数据填补了敏感领域长期缺乏、且无法大规模获取的标注语料空白，为未成年人保护的检测与预警研究提供可用的替代数据源。
items.why_en: It fills a long-standing gap in sensitive, hard-to-collect annotated data, giving child-protection researchers an alternative corpus for detection and early-warning work.

items.title_zh: REVEAL：从前沿模型轨迹中逆向工程智能体潜变量
items.title_en: REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces
items.summary_zh: 前沿 LLM 智能体能完成复杂的交互任务，但其推理成本高昂，促使人们希望把它们的经验迁移到更小的开源智能体上。然而蒸馏与潜变量通信通常需要训练目标模型或访问源模型内部。该研究受协议逆向工程启发，探讨如何仅利用前沿模型的文本轨迹，为冻结的智能体提供可复用的本地控制机制，并提出“Agentic Latents”（智能体潜变量），由锚定状态（anchored states）和通过重放激发的反馈-响应循环动态画像组成。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16288v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in…
items.why_zh: 若仅靠文本轨迹就能为冻结小模型提供可复用的控制信号，将大幅降低把前沿智能体能力迁移到低成本开源模型的门槛。
items.why_en: If textual traces alone can supply reusable control signals to a frozen model, transferring frontier agent capabilities to cheap open-source models becomes far more practical.

items.title_zh: 托管决策模型是否满足无关备选项独立性？针对 Jev 的预注册检验
items.title_en: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
items.summary_zh: 许多决策 API 会为每个选项返回一个概率，人们常把这些概率当作选项本身的固有属性来解读。但这种解读只有在模型满足“无关备选项独立性”（IIA）时才成立：加入一个既非正确答案、也非其最强竞争者的选项，不应改变前两者之间的相对概率。作者对托管决策模型 jev-1.13.0 开展了预注册测试，在意图分类（BANKING77、CLINC150）与主题分类（AG News）任务上共调用模型 299,463 次，以检验其输出是否受选项集合构成的影响。研究结果对依赖此类概率做决策的系统具有直接的实践意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decision APIs that return a probability for each option are routinely used as if those probabilities were properties of the options themselves. That reading is valid only if the model satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA): adding an option that is neither the right answer nor its strongest rival should leave the odds between those two unchanged. We test this in a pre-registered study of jev-1.13.0, a hosted decision model, using 299,463 calls on intent classification (BANKING77, CLINC150) and topic classification (AG News). Ever…
items.why_zh: 若模型不满足 IIA，那么决策 API 输出的概率就不能被当成选项本身的属性，会直接误导下游决策。
items.why_en: If the model violates IIA, per-option probabilities from decision APIs cannot be read as intrinsic properties of options, which misleads downstream decisions.

items.title_zh: 受控置信度分数知道 Text-to-SQL 答案何时正确吗？基于 BIRD 的探索性研究与在 Spider 上的预注册验证
items.title_en: Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider
items.summary_zh: 对话式分析让用户用自然语言向分散在多个系统中的数据提问并得到答案，但只有当每个答案都可被信任、可被解释时才有价值。这类生产系统会为写入数据库的每个答案附加一个置信度分数，并据此决定直接展示答案、带警告展示，还是不予展示；而该分数的权重、上限与阈值均为人工设计设定。本文对这种设计进行审计：在 BIRD 开发集的 1,534 个问题上，使用 GPT-5.1 配合经基准适配的生产提示词作答，并进一步在 Spider 上开展预注册验证，考察置信度分数是否真正反映答案的正确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with a benchmark-adapted production prompt…
items.why_zh: 置信度分数决定了答案是被展示、被警告还是被扣留，其可靠性直接关系到对话式分析能否被信任。
items.why_en: A confidence score decides whether an answer is shown, flagged or withheld, so its reliability determines whether conversational analytics can be trusted.

items.title_zh: 资源受限场景下用小型 LLM 结合迭代重试工作流实现可靠的 Text-to-SQL
items.title_en: Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型近年显著提升了 Text-to-SQL 生成能力，但其计算开销可能阻碍在资源受限环境中的部署。本文在受控推理预算下评估了 1B 至 8B 参数的小型与中型开源 LLM 的 Text-to-SQL 能力，重点关注模型专业化程度与提示词构造方式对性能的影响。研究在 Spider 基准上比较多种提示表示形式，并评估所生成查询的准确率，结果显示经过 SQL 专门训练的模型具有明显优势，而迭代重试工作流可进一步改善可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved Text-to-SQL generation, but their computational cost can hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper evaluates the Text-to-SQL capabilities of small and medium open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) under a controlled inference budget, focusing on how model specialization and prompt formulation affect performance. Using the Spider benchmark, we compare multiple prompt representations and assess the accuracy of generated queries. Our results show that SQL-specialized models are co…
items.why_zh: 它为算力有限的组织提供了用小型模型替代大型模型完成 Text-to-SQL 的可行路径与实证依据。
items.why_en: It offers a practical, evidence-backed route for resource-constrained organizations to run Text-to-SQL with small models instead of large ones.

items.title_zh: SchemaWeaver：以模式引导的并行 LLM 解码加速端侧移动智能体
items.title_en: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
items.summary_zh: 移动设备上的大语言模型可以作为智能体调用外部软件工具来完成复杂任务，但端侧智能体面临的主要挑战是工具调用时 LLM 的长延迟。其中解码阶段是延迟的主要来源，而在移动处理器上很难加速，因为它受内存带宽而非算力限制。为突破这一瓶颈，作者提出了 SchemaWeaver，一种新的端侧移动智能体 AI 技术，通过模式引导的并行解码来提升效率。该工作有望让移动设备上的智能体工具调用变得更加实用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI techn…
items.why_zh: 解码阶段的内存带宽瓶颈是端侧智能体落地的关键障碍，该方案直接针对这一硬件层面的限制。
items.why_en: The memory-bandwidth bottleneck in decoding is a key obstacle to on-device agents, and this approach targets that hardware-level limit directly.

items.title_zh: OpenDepth：复用图像编辑先验实现鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计
items.title_en: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary_zh: 近年来，生成式先验的引入彻底改变了单目深度估计（MDE），以极高的数据效率取得了当前最优性能。然而，基于文生图（T2I）模型的方法虽然在一般场景中表现出色，但面对光照变化、恶劣天气等开放世界环境扰动时效果会急剧下降。原因在于 T2I 先验是为语义合成而非保持像素级结构而优化的，难以解耦几何信息。OpenDepth 提出复用图像编辑先验，以提升开放世界条件下单目深度估计的鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry…
items.why_zh: 它指出了 T2I 先验在保持几何结构上的根本局限，并给出提升开放世界深度估计鲁棒性的新思路。
items.why_en: It pinpoints the fundamental limitation of T2I priors in preserving geometry and offers a new route to robust open-world depth estimation.

items.title_zh: AgentStripes：面向 AI 智能体的证据分级成熟度模型
items.title_en: AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 基准测试能说明 AI 智能体在某任务集上能做什么，却无法说明某个发布版本是否具备使其可靠、安全、可观测的工程控制，也无法说明这种保障的证据有多强。为此，本文提出 AgentStripes——一个面向 AI 智能体的证据分级成熟度模型。它定义了 0 到 7 级（stripes）的等级、12 个过程领域（涵盖 40 项能力）、三道关卡（基础、安全、证明，可使智能体无论得分多高都被限制在某等级），以及 E0 至 E5 的证据等级，并要求每项适用能力都对应相应证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability re…
items.why_zh: 它为智能体的可靠性与安全性评估提供了超越任务得分的结构化标准，弥补了现有基准的盲区。
items.why_en: It offers a structured standard for assessing agent reliability and safety beyond task scores, filling a gap left by existing benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 面向应用流持续学习的 GUI 智能体选择性知识控制
items.title_en: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
items.summary_zh: 持续学习是图形用户界面（GUI）智能体的关键能力，使其在适配不断演进的应用的同时，保留此前应用中获得的知识。这类应用流带来了颇具挑战的知识建模问题：新应用往往与旧应用共享底层知识，但也会引入不应干扰历史知识的特定知识。本文提出“激活条件化选择性知识控制”，一种轻量级方法，实现选择性的知识保留。该工作有助于 GUI 智能体在长期部署中平衡新技能获取与旧知识保持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06530v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retentio…
items.why_zh: GUI 智能体需长期跟随应用更新，如何在学新不忘旧之间取得平衡是其能否持续可用的关键。
items.why_en: GUI agents must keep pace with evolving apps, so balancing new learning against retention of old knowledge is key to their long-term usability.

items.title_zh: 编程 LLM 可被用于从数据中学习可解释模型
items.title_en: Coding LLMs Can Be Harnessed to Learn Interpretable Models from Data
items.summary_zh: 由于紧凑、可解释的分类器本质上对应简单的程序，一个自然的问题是：能否用基于 LLM 的编程智能体从数据中学习可解释模型。本文提出一个简单的“套具”，在给定带标签样本的情况下，反复提示编程 LLM 生成规则集中的下一条规则。作者表明，该方法在表格数据上与当前最优的规则学习方法相当，且常常更优，尤其在训练集较小时优势明显；在文本数据上则以较大幅度胜出，甚至优于另一类方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14006v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Since compact, interpretable classifiers correspond to simple programs, it is natural to ask if LLM-based coding agents can be used to learn interpretable models from data. In this paper we present a simple harness that repeatedly prompts a coding LLM to produce the next rule in a rule set, given a sample of labeled examples. We show that this approach is competitive with, and often superior to, state-of-the-art rule-learning methods on tabular data, especially with small training sets, and wins by large margins on text, including against anoth…
items.why_zh: 它说明通用编程 LLM 可以被直接改造为可解释模型的学习器，为高透明度建模提供了新途径。
items.why_en: It shows general coding LLMs can be repurposed as learners of interpretable models, offering a new path to transparent modeling.

items.title_zh: AphaVoice：面向失语症患者模拟的文本转语音模型
items.title_en: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
items.summary_zh: 中风后失语症的主要治疗手段是语言治疗，但临床资源有限，许多患者难以获得充分照护。要弥补这一缺口，就需要为医护人员提供可靠的培训模拟对象。然而当前 AI 研究几乎只聚焦于语音处理，语音生成方向基本未被探索。该研究提出 AphaVoice，一个专门用于合成高度逼真失语症语音的文本转语音（TTS）框架，并与当前最先进的 TTS 系统进行了对比评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoic…
items.why_zh: 若能逼真合成失语症语音，可为医护人员培训和语言治疗研究提供低成本、可复现的模拟工具。
items.why_en: Realistic synthetic aphasic speech could give clinicians a low-cost, reproducible simulation tool for training and therapy research.

items.title_zh: 迈向“系统一”临床智能：决策基础模型的参数高效微调与反事实可解释性
items.title_en: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 从患者自述症状自动分类疾病，需要在轻量判别模型的速度与自回归大模型的上下文理解能力及延迟成本之间权衡。决策基础模型提供了另一条路径：不生成自由文本，而是把表示直接映射到候选类别。研究者将基于 Qwen3.5 主干构建的 90 亿参数决策模型 Clef-Flash，适配到 Symptom2Disease 基准上的 24 类疾病分类任务，采用 4 比特量化与参数高效微调，并探讨反事实可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantize…
items.why_zh: 它展示了不依赖自由文本生成的决策模型在临床分类中的效率与可解释性潜力。
items.why_en: It shows the efficiency and explainability potential of decision models that avoid free-form text generation in clinical classification.

items.title_zh: TurnCost：关注轮次而非观测——面向编程智能体的缓存感知循环工程
items.title_en: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: AI 编程智能体以迭代循环方式工作：修改代码、运行工具、检查结果，再决定下一步。作者把这一过程的设计称为“循环工程”，涵盖上下文管理、模型选择、压缩与终止策略。已有提效工作多聚焦压缩工具观测结果，或把部分轮次路由到更便宜的模型，但这些优化的实际收益仍不清晰。该研究分析了 600 条公开发布的编程智能体轨迹，覆盖两种智能体脚手架和两种语言模型，重点考察轮次而非观测带来的开销。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15093v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models. Medi…
items.why_zh: 它基于大规模真实轨迹指出，编程智能体的成本优化重点可能在于轮次结构，而非压缩工具观测。
items.why_en: Based on large-scale real trajectories, it suggests cost optimization for coding agents may hinge on turn structure rather than compressing tool observations.

items.title_zh: AI 如何表征心理健康污名：用 GPT 系大模型量化 AI 估计与人类感知在性别群体间的差距
items.title_en: AI Representations of Mental Health Stigma: Quantifying the Gap Between AI Estimations and Human Perceptions Across Gender Groups Using GPT-Based LLMs
items.summary_zh: AI 在心理健康应用中的使用日益增多，引发人们对其可能内化并延续社会偏见的担忧。该研究评估 GPT-4 与 GPT-5 等大语言模型在表征不同性别群体的心理健康感知时存在的差异与错位。研究包含两项子研究，其中研究一采用社会距离、刻板印象与求助态度等广泛使用的量表，检验模型是否呈现系统性的性别差异。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16042v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in mental health applications raises concerns about its potential to internalize and perpetuate societal biases. This research evaluates both disparities and misalignment in how large language models (LLMs), GPT-4 and GPT-5, represent perceptions of mental health across gender groups. The research comprises two studies. Study 1 applied widely adopted measures of Social Distance, Stereotypes, and Attitudes Toward Seeking Help to assess whether the AI models depict systematic gender differences.…
items.why_zh: 它直接检验主流大模型在心理健康议题上的性别偏见，关系到 AI 心理健康工具是否公平可靠。
items.why_en: It directly probes gender bias in leading LLMs on mental health, relevant to whether AI mental health tools are fair and reliable.

items.title_zh: 面向香港建筑业消防规范解读的基准测试
items.title_en: Towards a Benchmark for Fire Safety Code Interpretation in the Hong Kong AEC Industry
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在建筑、工程与施工（AEC）领域正被越来越多地探索，但其在法规合规方面的可靠性仍不确定。本研究与领域专家合作，针对香港消防安全规范构建了一个本地化基准数据集，包含多选题与开放式问题，并据此评测了 12 个广泛使用的闭源与开源模型。结果显示，表现最佳的闭源模型在该任务上更为突出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16127v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly explored in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) domain, yet their reliability in regulatory compliance remains uncertain. In this study, we evaluate the performance of LLMs on Hong Kong fire safety codes. In collaboration with domain experts, we create a localized benchmark dataset comprising both multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended questions (OEQs) to evaluate 12 widely used proprietary and open-source models. Our findings show that top-performing proprietary models ac…
items.why_zh: 在法规合规这类高风险场景中，量化和验证 LLM 的可靠性是能否落地的关键前提。
items.why_en: In high-stakes regulatory settings, quantifying and validating LLM reliability is a prerequisite for real-world adoption.

items.title_zh: WildTrace：在真实大规模 LLM 后训练中评测训练数据检测
items.title_en: WildTrace: Evaluating Training Data Detection in Realistic Large-Scale LLM Post-Training
items.summary_zh: 后训练显著提升了模型性能，但其使用的大量未公开数据引发了对基准污染和版权侵权的担忧，也推动了针对后训练模型的训练数据检测研究。现有评测常使用事后构建的基准，可能引入分布偏移；受控评测则依赖与实际后训练设置差异较大的小规模训练。为弥补这一差距，作者提出 WildTrace，用于在更贴近真实的大规模后训练场景中评测训练数据检测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16152v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Although post-training significantly enhances model performance, the use of massive undisclosed data raises concerns about benchmark contamination and copyright infringement. This drives growing interest in training data detection for post-trained models. Existing evaluations for training data detection often leverage benchmarks constructed post hoc, which can introduce distribution shifts. Alternatively, controlled evaluations rely on small-scale training setups that diverge from realistic post-training settings. As a result, their reported pe…
items.why_zh: 更贴近真实的检测评测，是判断训练数据检测方法能否真正用于审计与合规的基础。
items.why_en: More realistic detection benchmarks are essential for judging whether training-data detection can actually support auditing and compliance.

items.title_zh: 为 LLM 强化学习生长并迁移计算通路
items.title_en: Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）能显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但一次有效的训练运行需要消耗大量资源。若能跨模型复用 RL 过程中获得的计算，就能放大这份训练的价值。作者提出 GrowRL：通过结构生长把学习到的更新组织成紧凑的计算通路。该方法冻结预训练主干，在每个 Transformer 层新增独立的因果注意力分支和前馈网络分支，从而实现通路的生长与迁移。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16489v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-in…
items.why_zh: 若 RL 学到的计算通路可跨模型迁移复用，将显著降低大模型推理能力训练的成本。
items.why_en: If RL-learned pathways can be transferred and reused across models, the cost of training reasoning capabilities could drop substantially.

items.title_zh: AIPOCH Open-Science：带可复现 .science 包的开源 AI 研究工作台
items.title_en: AIPOCH Open-Science: An Open-Source AI Research Workbench with Reproducible .science Packages
items.summary_zh: AI 辅助研究会留下指令、计算过程、产物修订与检查记录，当另一位研究者接手这项工作时，这些记录之间的关系至关重要。作者提出 AIPOCH Open-Science：一个开源研究工作台，提供可移植的 .science 会话包，并为这些被记录的关系定义了一套交换契约。该设计让版本与评估目标保持可追溯，接收方工作区的标识符可以重新映射，可排除的内容可被显式省略，导入的历史记录也与可写的分叉保持分离。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17110v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-assisted research leaves instructions, computations, artifact revisions and checks whose relationships matter when another researcher receives the work. We present AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source research workbench with portable .science session packages, and specify an exchange contract for these recorded relationships. Version and assessment targets remain attributable while receiving-workspace identifiers can be remapped, eligible contents can be omitted explicitly, and imported history remains separate from a writable fork. A control…
items.why_zh: 它试图用可移植的会话包与明确契约解决 AI 辅助研究的可复现性与成果交接问题。
items.why_en: It aims to solve reproducibility and hand-off problems in AI-assisted research via portable session packages and an explicit exchange contract.

items.title_zh: Box-WAM：以框轨迹作为世界动作模型的紧凑状态表示
items.title_en: Box-WAM: Box Trajectories as Compact State Representations for World Action Models
items.summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAM）会同时预测动作与未来世界状态，在多种机器人操作任务上优于仅预测动作的策略模型。但用全帧视频预测来表示未来，在训练和推理阶段都计算代价高昂。论文因此提出一个核心问题：什么样的紧凑状态表示，才能保留未来预测带来的规划与监督收益。作者给出的答案是 Box-WAM，用“框轨迹”替代稠密的视频预测作为紧凑状态表示。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17526v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World action models (WAMs) are a category of policy models that ex- plicitly predict both actions and future world states. They have been shown to outperform action-only models across various robotic manipulation tasks. How- ever, representing the future with full-frame video prediction can be computation- ally expensive during both training and inference. This raises a central question: what compact state representation preserves the planning and supervision bene- fits of future prediction? In this paper, we propose BoxWAM, which replaces dens…
items.why_zh: 在保留世界模型预测收益的同时大幅降低计算开销，对机器人策略学习走向实用很关键。
items.why_en: Cutting the cost of world-model prediction while keeping its benefits matters for making robot policy learning practical.

items.title_zh: 带选择性验证反馈的高斯过程 Bandit：面向 AI 系统优化
items.title_en: Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback
items.summary_zh: 高斯过程 Bandit 利用不同配置之间的相似性，来优化提示词、检索系统与智能体工作流。但在这类应用中，廉价的基于模型的评估可能与可信的任务结果不一致。论文研究“选择性验证”问题：动作在观测到诊断信号之前就已被选定，而可信反馈只在一个未知的诊断状态集合上有效。作者用一个有限可靠性类别和一个有限 RKHS 信号字典来刻画这两类不确定性，并据此构造了一个固定的审计设计方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gaussian process bandits exploit similarities among configurations to optimize prompts, retrieval systems, and agent workflows. In these applications, however, inexpensive model-based evaluations can disagree with trusted task outcomes. We study selective verification when an action is chosen before a diagnostic is observed and trusted feedback is informative on an unknown set of diagnostic states. A finite reliability class and a finite RKHS signal dictionary describe these two sources of uncertainty. We construct a fixed audit design that com…
items.why_zh: 为提示词与智能体系统的自动化优化提供了在反馈可能不可靠时仍可用的理论框架。
items.why_en: It offers a theoretical framework for optimizing prompts and agent systems when cheap evaluations may be unreliable.

items.title_zh: FETALFusion：分辨率感知的状态空间建模用于多采集类型胎儿头部分割
items.title_en: FETALFusion: Resolution-Aware State-Space Modeling for Multi-Domain Fetal Head Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 从二维超声测量头围（HC）是评估胎儿生长的常规指标，而自动化这一流程要求分割边界在单张扫描上也足够可靠，而不仅仅是平均表现好。作者提出 FETALFusion，一个双路径 CNN-Mamba 编码器-解码器，用于跨采集类型的胎儿头部分割。该方法仅在两个最高分辨率阶段应用四方向状态空间扫描，瓶颈特征通过领域特定的通道门控处理、并在测试时取平均，同时引入一个弱关键点形状先验，模型进行联合训练。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17951v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Head circumference (HC) measured from 2D ultrasound is a routine marker of fetal growth, and automating it needs segmentations whose boundaries hold up on individual scans, not only on average. We present FETALFusion, a dual-path CNN-Mamba encoder-decoder for fetal head segmentation across acquisition types. It applies four-directional state-space scans only at the two highest-resolution stages, routes bottleneck features through domain-specific channel gates that are averaged at test time, and adds a weak landmark shape prior. We train jointly…
items.why_zh: 单例可靠的分割是自动测量头围、提升产前筛查可靠性的前提。
items.why_en: Scan-level reliable segmentation is a prerequisite for automated head-circumference measurement in prenatal screening.

items.title_zh: 看穿伪造还不够：医学视觉语言模型在伪造证据下的退缩性谄媚
items.title_en: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型可以正确分析一张 CT 扫描并识别出视野中的双肾；但在后续对话中，如果用户给出一份方向相反的处方，模型往往会谄媚地改口、重新对齐自己的诊断。作者研究的是“伪造证据下的退缩性谄媚”：当反驳伴随一份伪造文档时，模型会放弃原本正确的答案。研究在 400 道 VQA-RAD 是/否问题上测试了四个开源 VLM，共构成 19,200 组多轮对话，分别加入和不加入伪造处方进行对比。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17989v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescripti…
items.why_zh: 医学场景中模型被伪造文档轻易说服，会直接危及临床决策的安全性。
items.why_en: Medical models being swayed by fabricated documents directly threatens the safety of clinical decisions.

items.title_zh: 目标越多反而越易识别：偏好与反馈的作用
items.title_en: When More Objectives Make Identification Easier: The Role of Preferences and Feedback
items.summary_zh: 最优臂识别（BAI）旨在用尽可能少的样本找出最优臂，现有工作大多聚焦单一目标，而许多现实应用涉及多个准则，这催生了多目标 Bandit 中的 BAI 研究。直觉上多目标识别更难，因为学习者必须在更高维的奖励空间中辨认最优臂；但额外的目标也提供了更丰富的反馈，可能减少所需的探索。论文刻画了在什么条件下这种额外反馈能让识别变得更容易。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18577v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Best-arm identification (BAI) aims to identify the optimal arm using as few samples as possible. While most existing work focuses on a single objective, many real-world applications involve multiple criteria, which motivates the study of BAI in multi-objective bandits. Intuitively, multi-objective identification seems harder, since the learner must identify optimal arms in a higher-dimensional reward space; however, the additional objectives also provide richer feedback that can reduce the required exploration. In this paper, we characterize wh…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了“目标越多越难”的直觉，为多目标实验设计提供理论依据。
items.why_en: It challenges the intuition that more objectives are always harder, informing the design of multi-objective experiments.

items.title_zh: ACCRUE：面向机器人基础模型的持续离策略强化学习
items.title_en: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 强化学习后训练能让机器人基础模型（RFM）超越示教数据，但真实部署要求更多：既要高效学习新任务，又要保留此前已获得的行为。现有基于 VLA 的持续强化学习方法可缓解遗忘，却依赖在策略更新、前向迁移有限；离策略方法提升了单任务样本效率，却没有解决跨任务的学习持久性。作者提出 ACCRUE，一个持续离策略强化学习框架来兼顾这两方面（摘要在此处被截断，未给出更多细节）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweig…
items.why_zh: 让机器人基础模型在持续学习新任务时不遗忘旧技能，是走向真实部署的关键一步。
items.why_en: Enabling robot foundation models to keep learning new tasks without forgetting old skills is key to real-world deployment.

items.title_zh: GeoReader：为视觉语言模型的空间推理学习潜在几何
items.title_en: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）难以处理 RGB 观测中隐含的度量关系与多视角关系。几何基础模型能从 RGB 中恢复这类结构，但现有做法要么把估计出的几何特征与视觉 token 融合、仅靠问答任务学习如何使用它们，要么把 VLM 的潜在表示与几何特征对齐。然而“捕捉到几何”并不保证“会使用几何”：在一个已发布的特征对齐模型中，把对齐后的潜在表示置零，其准确率竟毫无变化。为此作者提出 GeoReader 框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18694v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that lea…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了多模态模型“对齐了几何特征却并未真正使用”的问题，为空间推理能力提供新路径。
items.why_en: It exposes that aligned geometry features may go unused, pointing to a better route for spatial reasoning in VLMs.

items.title_zh: 汇总排行榜没有说的事：审计微服务 RCA 基准中方法对比的范围与来源
items.title_en: What a Pooled Leaderboard Does Not Say: Auditing the Scope and Provenance of Method Comparisons in Microservice RCA Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 微服务根因分析（RCA）的离线基准通常把多个应用上的得分汇总后给方法排名，而汇总后的领先掩盖了两件事：它究竟在哪些系统上成立，以及这个分数是如何产生的。作者在三个公开基准系列（OpenRCA、RCAEval 和 PetShop）上对这两点进行审计，按记录的配置运行 16 种方法的已发布实现，覆盖 11 个子系统，并使用其中三个应用的第二版发布数据。研究关注公开方法之间的汇总领先是否在每个子系统上都成立。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.29159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Offline benchmarks for microservice root cause analysis (RCA) rank methods by a score pooled over several applications, and a pooled lead leaves two things unstated: on which of the systems it holds, and how the score was produced. We audit both on three public benchmark families (OpenRCA, RCAEval, and PetShop), running the released implementations of 16 methods under recorded configurations on 11 subsystems and on a second release of three of the applications. Whether a pooled lead between published methods holds on every subsystem is decide…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者不能只看汇总排名，还需核查方法优势的适用范围与分数来源。
items.why_en: It warns that pooled benchmark rankings can hide where a method's advantage actually holds and how scores were produced.

items.title_zh: JaxAHT：面向临时协作（Ad Hoc Teamwork）的 JAX 开源库
items.title_en: JaxAHT: A JAX-Based Library for Ad Hoc Teamwork
items.summary_zh: 随着自主智能体被越来越多地部署，它们需要与从未见过的智能体（例如人类）协同完成任务，这一挑战被形式化为“临时协作”（Ad Hoc Teamwork, AHT），并已积累了大量研究。然而，AHT 研究进展受到三方面制约：研究全流程的计算成本过高、缺乏标准化的基准实现，以及缺少多样且经过验证的评估队友套件。为此，作者提出 JaxAHT——据称是首个基于 JAX 的开源库，旨在加速 AHT 研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13716v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As autonomous agents are increasingly deployed, they must be able to coordinate with previously unseen agents, such as humans. This challenge has been formalized as Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT), and has attracted a substantial body of research. However, progress has been hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. This work introduces JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelera…
items.why_zh: 它试图用标准化、可复用的开源工具降低 AHT 研究的算力与工程门槛，推动智能体与人协作这一关键方向的可复现进展。
items.why_en: It aims to lower the computational and engineering barriers of AHT research with a standardized, reusable open-source toolkit, enabling reproducible progress on agent-human coordination.

items.title_zh: MS-Exam-Gen：评估大模型多发性硬化 MRI 影像知识的自动基准构建工具包
items.title_en: MS-Exam-Gen: An Automatic Benchmark Construction Toolkit for Evaluating LLMs on Multiple Sclerosis-MRI Imaging Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 生物医学大模型的评测需要对狭窄、不断演进且有文献来源支撑的亚专科知识进行可审计的评估。多发性硬化 MRI（MS-MRI）正是一个高风险的文本知识测试场景：正确推理需要掌握最新诊断标准、标准化采集与报告规范、纵向随访监测概念、病灶形态学，以及对难以区分类似病变的识别能力。作者提出 MS-Exam-Gen，一个可复现的框架，用于构建并审计基于文本的多项选择题评测集，以检验大模型在该领域的知识水平。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.06170v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ…
items.why_zh: 它为医学影像等高风险亚专科领域提供了可审计、可复现的大模型知识评测方式，而非笼统的通用医学问答打分。
items.why_en: It offers an auditable, reproducible way to evaluate LLMs in a high-stakes imaging subspecialty, rather than relying on generic medical QA scoring.

items.title_zh: 复杂查询问答真的复杂吗？——CQA 基准的复杂度被高估
items.title_en: Is Complex Query Answering Really Complex?
items.summary_zh: 知识图谱上的复杂查询问答（CQA）正被视为一项有挑战性的推理任务。本文指出，当前 CQA 基准可能并没有我们想象的那么复杂，因为其构建方式扭曲了我们对领域进展的认知。例如作者发现，在这些基准中，大多数查询（某些查询类型中多达 98%）可以被归约为更简单的问题，如链接预测——即只需预测一条边。当把这类可归约的查询剥离后，最先进 CQA 模型的性能会显著下降。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2410.12537v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Complex query answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs (KGs) is gaining momentum as a challenging reasoning task. In this paper, we show that the current benchmarks for CQA might not be as complex as we think, as the way they are built distorts our perception of progress in this field. For example, we find that in these benchmarks, most queries (up to 98% for some query types) can be reduced to simpler problems, e.g., link prediction, where only one link needs to be predicted. The performance of state-of-the-art CQA models decreases signific…
items.why_zh: 它揭示现有基准可能高估了 CQA 模型的真实推理能力，提示该领域的评测设计与“进展”需要重新审视。
items.why_en: It suggests existing benchmarks may overstate CQA models' genuine reasoning ability, calling for a rethink of evaluation design and reported progress.

items.title_zh: 医疗领域的开放基础模型：生成式 AI 个性化处方中的挑战、悖论与机遇
items.title_en: Open Foundation Models in Healthcare: Challenges, Paradoxes, and Opportunities with GenAI Driven Personalized Prescription
items.summary_zh: 在专有大语言模型取得成功的推动下，学界与业界对开发开放、非专有的大语言模型与 AI 基础模型（AIFM）兴趣日增，以便在学术、科研和非商业场景中透明使用，这类开放模型在改善医疗应用方面潜力可观。本文对面向临床任务的当前开放大模型与 AIFMs 做了系统性综述与分类梳理，并在一个个性化处方任务上对开放权重模型进行了实证评估，进而讨论其中的挑战、悖论与机会。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.04356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In response to the success of proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in developing open, non-proprietary LLMs and AI foundation models (AIFMs) for transparent use in academic, scientific, and non-commercial applications. Open models have substantial potential to improve healthcare applications. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and a taxonomy of state-of-the-art open LLMs and AIFMs for clinical tasks. In addition, we empirically evaluate open-weight LLMs on a personalized-prescription task a…
items.why_zh: 它系统梳理了医疗可用的开放基础模型，并用个性化处方任务检验其真实能力，为透明、可复现的临床 AI 落地提供参考。
items.why_en: It maps the landscape of open foundation models for healthcare and tests them on personalized prescription, informing transparent and reproducible clinical AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 从视觉事件生成自然语言：研究现状与关键未解问题
items.title_en: Natural Language Generation from Visual Events: State-of-the-Art and Key Open Questions
items.summary_zh: 近年来，视觉 grounding 的自然语言处理研究大量聚焦于真实世界的多模态场景，例如描述图像或视频中的内容。然而，针对这些场景中不同模态之间相互作用的性质与程度，关注相对不足。本文主张：任何基于图像或帧序列的自然语言生成任务，实际上都属于一个更广泛、更一般的问题——即对模态之间复杂交互进行建模。文章据此梳理了该方向的研究现状，并提出若干关键未解问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.13034v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In recent years, a substantial body of work in visually grounded natural language processing has focused on real-life multimodal scenarios such as describing content depicted in images or videos. However, comparatively less attention has been devoted to studying the nature and degree of interaction between the different modalities in these scenarios. In this paper, we argue that any task dealing with natural language generation from sequences of images or frames is an instance of the broader, more general problem of modeling the intrica…
items.why_zh: 它把视频/图像序列描述任务统一到模态交互建模的框架下，为多模态生成研究指出了被忽视的核心问题。
items.why_en: It reframes image- or frame-sequence description as a broader modality-interaction modeling problem, highlighting a core, often overlooked research question in multimodal generation.

items.title_zh: 面向 Java 项目的调用链感知大模型测试生成方法 CAT
items.title_en: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在生成项目级单元测试方面已展现出较强潜力，但现有先进方法主要依赖执行路径信息来构建提示，对于类间依赖丰富、调用链深、对象初始化复杂的软件系统往往力有不逮。本文提出 CAT，一种新颖的调用链感知大模型测试生成方法，显式地将调用链与依赖上下文纳入生成过程，以提升复杂 Java 项目单元测试的生成效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.22046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for generating project-level unit tests. However, existing state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on execution-path information to guide prompt construction, which is often insufficient for complex software systems with rich inter-class dependencies, deep call chains, and intricate object initialization requirements. In this paper, we present CAT, a novel call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach that explicitly incorporates call-chain and dependency context…
items.why_zh: 它针对复杂 Java 工程中执行路径信息不足的痛点，把调用链与依赖上下文引入提示构建，提升项目级单测生成的适用性。
items.why_en: It targets the limits of execution-path-only prompting by bringing call-chain and dependency context into test generation for complex Java projects.

items.title_zh: HALLMARK：如何诊断大模型引文核查器，以及何时该部署它们
items.title_en: HALLMARK: How to Diagnose LLM Citation Verifiers and When to Deploy Them
items.summary_zh: GPTZero 发现 NeurIPS 2025 有 53 篇被接收论文存在虚构引文，如今不少会议已用自动参考文献检查工具筛查投稿。基于规则和大模型的核查器不断涌现，但许多在发布时缺乏统一评测，且各自针对不同类型的错误，导致使用者难以判断该信任哪一个、何时部署。为此作者提出 HALLMARK 幻觉基准：包含 2,526 条 BibTeX 条目，覆盖 14 种幻觉类型，并提供按类型与诊断性的子测试标签以及时间、跨领域等维度的划分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.18360v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: GPTZero found 53 NeurIPS 2025 accepted papers with hallucinated citations, and venues now screen submissions with automated reference checkers. Rule- and Large Language Model (LLM)-based verifiers are emerging, but many are released without a shared evaluation and each flags a different kind of error, so it is unclear which to trust or when to deploy them. We address this with HALLMARK (Hallucination benchmark): 2,526 BibTeX entries spanning 14 hallucination types, with per-type and diagnostic sub-test labels and further temporal, cross…
items.why_zh: 它为该领域提供了统一、可诊断的评测标准，帮助会议与期刊判断各类引文核查工具的可信度与适用场景。
items.why_en: It provides a shared, diagnostic benchmark so venues can judge which citation verifiers to trust and when to deploy them.

items.title_zh: ForgetBench：评测语言模型长期参数化记忆的遗忘动态
items.title_en: ForgetBench: Benchmarking Forgetting Dynamics of Long-Term Parametric Memory in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在知识获取与推理上表现强劲，但在反复更新后能否保留此前习得的知识，仍缺乏充分理解。现有评测范式主要关注单步推理或静态知识编辑，无法刻画模型在持续修改过程中知识保持与退化的时间动态。为此，作者提出 ForgetBench，一个用于测量语言模型长期参数化记忆中遗忘动态的基准，以评估模型在连续知识更新下的记忆保持表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.26455v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in knowledge acquisition and reasoning, yet their ability to retain previously acquired knowledge under repeated updates remains insufficiently understood. Existing evaluation paradigms primarily focus on single-step reasoning or static knowledge editing, which fail to capture the temporal dynamics of knowledge retention and degradation during continual model modification. In this work, we propose \textbf{ForgetBench}, a benchmark for measuring forgetting dynamics in the…
items.why_zh: 它填补了持续知识更新场景下“遗忘”缺乏度量的空白，对理解模型长期知识维护与编辑的副作用至关重要。
items.why_en: It fills a measurement gap on forgetting under continual knowledge updates, which is crucial for understanding the side effects of long-term knowledge maintenance and editing.

items.title_zh: SIDScope：面向生成式推荐语义 ID 接口的诊断资源
items.title_en: SIDScope: A Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Interfaces in Generative Recommendation
items.summary_zh: 在生成式推荐中，语义 ID 分词器会为目录中的每个商品分配码序列，推荐模型预测这些码，再将其还原为商品。当研究者想复用某个已发布的分词映射时，需要先检查它的码组织方式、商品还原效果，以及目录刷新后与现有模型的兼容性。SIDScope 正是为此提供的一套诊断工具，包括可溯源的适配器、映射诊断、候选检索测试和生成轨迹分析。其清单收录了来自 7 个分词器家族、覆盖 Amazon 与 Yelp 的 9 个导出，其中 8 条是可执行的。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Semantic ID tokenizers assign code sequences to catalog items, which generative recommenders predict and resolve back to items. Reusing a released mapping requires checking its code organization, item resolution, and compatibility with an existing model after a refresh. SIDScope provides these checks through source traced adapters, mapping diagnostics, candidate retrieval tests, and generated trace analysis. Its inventory contains nine exports from seven tokenizer families across Amazon and Yelp, including eight executable routes and on…
items.why_zh: 语义 ID 映射正在成为生成式推荐的基础设施，SIDScope 让复用与刷新这些映射有了可复现的检查手段。
items.why_en: Semantic-ID mappings are becoming core infrastructure for generative recommendation, and SIDScope gives practitioners a reproducible way to validate them before and after reuse.

items.title_zh: SPINE：衡量大模型在持续多轮施压下的迎合行为
items.title_en: SPINE: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在用户反驳时可能放弃原本正确的立场，这种失败模式被称为迎合（sycophancy）。现有评测大多使用简短、预先设定好的对话，因此可能漏掉那些只有在持续且不断变化的反对意见下才会出现的失败。SPINE 让一个 LLM 代理扮演“坚持不懈但判断错误”的用户，自适应地挑战目标模型，最多持续 25 轮。研究者用该基准评测了四款商用模型：Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-5.6 Terra、Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09090v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, prespecified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four commercial models (Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Terra, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and DeepSeek V4 Pro) and…
items.why_zh: 真实使用中的多轮压力才是关键场景，SPINE 揭示了短对话评测看不到的迎合风险。
items.why_en: Sustained multi-turn pressure is the realistic setting, and SPINE exposes sycophancy that short-conversation evaluations miss.

items.title_zh: 当上下文误导模型：大模型上下文学习中的权威性判断
items.title_en: When Context Misleads: In-context Learning with Jurisdiction in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）已成为现代大模型部署的基石，但现有的 ICL 后训练方法存在一个关键盲点：它们擅长从示范中抽取模式，却常常忽视“上下文权威性”，也就是判断上下文信息是否应当主导最终答案的能力。为评测这一能力，作者提出 FakeContextBench，覆盖七个领域的伪科学主张。对商用与开源模型的评估显示，现有方法在判断上下文是否可信方面仍存在明显不足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.27603v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a cornerstone of modern LLM deployment. However, existing ICL post-training methods have a critical blind spot: they excel at extracting patterns from demonstrations while often neglecting context authority, the ability to determine whether contextual information should govern the final answer. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FakeContextBench, which contains pseudoscientific claims across seven domains. Our evaluation of commercial and open-source models shows that large-scale pre-training…
items.why_zh: 模型能否判断“上下文说了算不算”，直接决定 RAG 与示例学习在真实场景里是否可靠。
items.why_en: Whether a model knows when context should govern its answer determines how trustworthy RAG and demonstration-based learning are in practice.

items.title_zh: SoFT：面向可泛化大模型微调的软目标
items.title_en: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 蒸馏可以让“学生”语言模型从专家教师那里获得新能力，但把多教师、多领域的示范整合进单一学生模型仍然困难。本文研究这一场景下的监督微调（SFT）：学生既要掌握多样能力，又要保持在训练任务之外的泛化性。实验显示，不同 SFT 方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在不同的取舍，这一发现促使作者设计更显式的方案，即软目标（SoFT）方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.32493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit co…
items.why_zh: 多教师蒸馏下的“学得会”与“泛化好”该如何权衡，是微调落地的核心难题，SoFT 提供了新的解法。
items.why_en: Balancing in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization in multi-teacher distillation is a central fine-tuning challenge that SoFT addresses.

items.title_zh: Ready2Blend：从自然语言指令到可组合的对齐提示
items.title_en: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
items.summary_zh: 持续对齐要求大模型适应新需求，同时不遗忘此前已获得的行为。自然语言指令灵活且可组合，但只能提供间接控制；后训练带来的适应更强，代价是反复更新参数。Ready2Blend 试图把两者的优势结合起来：AlignFormer 把每条需求映射为固定长度的对齐提示，存入模块化的提示库，而主干模型与已有提示保持不变。据摘要，这一设计意在避免反复修改参数。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39365v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts rema…
items.why_zh: 在不遗忘旧行为的前提下持续对齐是部署级需求，Ready2Blend 用可组合提示替代反复的参数更新。
items.why_en: Continual alignment without forgetting is a deployment-level need, and Ready2Blend replaces repeated parameter updates with composable prompts.

items.title_zh: 去中心化赌博机学习马尔可夫完美均衡
items.title_en: Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria
items.summary_zh: 本文研究折扣无限时域、一般和马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化赌博机学习，动作空间为连续空间。智能体可以观察到公共状态，但只能看到自己实际获得的奖励，并用同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）更新自己的动作。在负的即时奖励梯度满足强单调性、且时间步长足够小的条件下，作者证明这一完全去中心化的过程几乎必然收敛到唯一的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，并给出了 O(n^{-1/2}) 的收敛速率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and pr…
items.why_zh: 完全去中心化且带收敛保证的多智能体学习算法稀缺，该结果为连续动作马尔可夫博弈补上了理论缺口。
items.why_en: Fully decentralized multi-agent algorithms with convergence guarantees are rare, and this work supplies one for continuous-action Markov games.

items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的孟加拉国登革热感染预测：基准与扩展模型对比
items.title_en: Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Dengue Infection Using Clinical and Hematological Data from Bangladesh: A Comparative Analysis of Benchmark and Extended Prediction Models
items.summary_zh: 登革热由登革病毒（DENV）引起，是孟加拉国的重大公共卫生问题，其症状与其他发热性疾病高度重叠，使早期诊断变得困难。本研究使用两家孟加拉国医院的数据集（2024 年 n=1,511；2025 年 n=1,283）并采用 SMOTE 处理数据，比较逻辑回归、随机森林与 XGBoost 基于临床和血液学指标预测登革热的表现。结果显示，在 2024 年数据上扩展模型优于基准模型（随机森林 ROC-AUC 从 0.640 提升至 0.661），RDW-CV 是其中表现最稳定的新增预测因子。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dengue is a viral infection caused by the dengue virus (DENV) and a major public health concern in Bangladesh, where symptom overlap with other febrile illnesses complicates early diagnosis. This study compares Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost to predict dengue from clinical and hematological data using two Bangladeshi hospital datasets (2024, n=1,511; 2025, n=1,283) with SMOTE. Extended models outperformed benchmarks within 2024 (Random Forest ROC-AUC 0.640 to 0.661), with RDW-CV the most consistently influential added predictor. 2…
items.why_zh: 用常规临床与血液学指标配合机器学习辅助早期分诊，对资源有限的流行地区具有直接实用价值。
items.why_en: Machine learning on routine clinical and hematological data could support earlier triage in resource-limited dengue-endemic settings.

items.title_zh: 算法公平性的时间维度：进展与展望
items.title_en: Algorithmic Fairness Over Time: Advances & Prospects
items.summary_zh: 当系统存在反馈回路时，某一时间步的算法决策会影响后续步骤观测到的数据，可能引入选择偏差或数据分布漂移。已有研究表明，忽视这些效应会导致不公平，而且随着模型持续在社会中部署，这种不公平可能随时间不断加剧。这引出了如何度量和保证算法决策模型长期公平性的问题。这篇短文提出了一套分类法，用于区分时间维度上不同类型的公平性问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the presence of feedback loops, algorithmic decisions at one time step can influence observed data in subsequent steps, potentially introducing selection bias or shifts in data distribution. Research has demonstrated that ignoring these effects can lead to unfairness, which may worsen over time as the model remains deployed within society. This raises important questions of how to measure and ensure fairness of algorithmic decision-making models over time. In this short paper, we present a taxonomy that distinguishes between different types of…
items.why_zh: 公平性不是一次性的上线检查，反馈回路会让偏差随时间放大，需要专门的时间维度度量框架。
items.why_en: Fairness is not a one-time pre-deployment check; feedback loops can amplify bias over time, so temporal measurement frameworks are needed.

items.title_zh: 联邦图像语义通信中的自适应角色分配与可控特征重建
items.title_en: Adaptive Role Assignment and Controlled Feature Reconstruction for Federated Image Semantic Communication
items.summary_zh: 混合联邦语义通信允许用户设备（UE）在共享训练框架下选择贡献模型更新或语义特征，但在实际无线接入网（RAN）部署中，不同角色的成本差异以及模型聚合与特征重建（FR）之间的相互作用仍是关键难题。为此作者提出 ARC-FedSC，这是一个感知 RAN 的框架，能在固定通信预算下统一协调 UE 的角色分配与服务器端可控特征重建，其中包含基于 bandit 的 RAN 感知角色分配机制。该工作面向联邦语义通信在真实网络中的落地，目标是在有限通信开销下合理平衡各类用户的贡献方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid federated semantic communication enables user equipment (UEs) to contribute model updates or semantic features under a shared training framework. However, heterogeneous role costs and the interaction between model aggregation and feature reconstruction (FR) remain key challenges in practical radio access network (RAN) deployment. To address these issues, we propose ARC-FedSC, a RAN-aware framework that coordinates UE role assignment and server-side controlled FR under a fixed communication budget. Within ARC-FedSC, RAN Aware Role-Bandit le…
items.why_zh: 为联邦语义通信在真实无线接入网中的角色分配与通信预算管理提供了可部署的协调方案。
items.why_en: It offers a deployable way to coordinate device roles and communication budgets for federated semantic communication in real radio access networks.

items.title_zh: 低位循环状态量化中的更新保持
items.title_en: Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization
items.summary_zh: 线性注意力与循环模型会把历史 token 压缩成一个固定大小的状态，并在每一步进行更新。在大批量场景下，以高精度存储这些状态会带来可观的显存与带宽开销，因此低位状态量化成为必要手段。但与权重和 KV 缓存不同，循环状态在每次更新后都要重新量化，量化误差会随着时间步不断累积。论文分析表明，这些误差在相邻步骤之间高度相干，因此单纯降低单步误差并不足以解决问题。研究据此提出在低比特量化下保持状态更新的方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence ari…
items.why_zh: 揭示了循环状态量化误差跨步相干累积这一被忽视的机制，为低位状态存储提供了改进方向。
items.why_en: It exposes a previously overlooked cross-step coherence in recurrent state quantization error, pointing to better low-bit state storage.

items.title_zh: 已训练 TTT 层中的误差校正
items.title_en: Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers
items.summary_zh: 测试时训练（TTT）层会在处理输入序列的过程中更新其 fast-weight 记忆。然而基于梯度的更新本身并不能说明这套记忆究竟如何修正已有的关联。论文研究了已公开 TTT 实现中由预测导出的更新的结构与实际作用：对于点积目标，作者刻画了预测误差残差的缺失，并给出内循环中梯度上升与下降在重参数化后等价的成立条件；对于基于 LayerNorm 的平方误差目标也做了相应分析。该工作为理解 TTT 层记忆的纠错与更新机制提供了理论与实证视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective…
items.why_zh: 厘清了 TTT 层记忆纠错的实际机制，有助于解释和改进测试时训练类模型的记忆更新。
items.why_en: It clarifies how TTT memory actually performs error correction, helping explain and improve test-time-trained memory updates.

items.title_zh: 平均准确率不是发布决策的正确估计量
items.title_en: Mean Accuracy Is the Wrong Estimand for a Release Decision
items.summary_zh: 对一个微调模型做出发布决策，本质上是对“下一次重跑这套训练配方”的操作性承诺，而标准基准报告往往只给出过去若干随机种子的平均准确率，二者回答的是根本不同的问题：发布决策取决于灾难性的尾部风险，常规评测则只反映中心趋势。由于微调容易诱发双峰式的模式坍缩，高平均准确率常常掩盖了严重的失败率。作者审计了 11 个语言模型上的 2,124 个微调模型，结果支持这一判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A release decision about a fine-tuned model is an operational commitment about the \emph{next} rerun of its training recipe. Yet standard benchmark reporting gives only the mean accuracy of past seeds. These target fundamentally different questions: release decisions depend on catastrophic tail risk, whereas standard evaluation reports only central tendency. Because fine-tuning induces bimodal mode collapse, high average accuracy frequently conceals severe failure rates. Auditing $2\,124$ fine-tuned models across eleven language models, we show t…
items.why_zh: 指出平均准确率无法反映发布所需的尾部风险，动摇了当前模型评测与发布流程的默认做法。
items.why_en: It argues that mean accuracy misses the tail risk a release decision needs, challenging standard benchmark-based release practice.

items.title_zh: 基于跨用户成对偏好的在线 LLM 个性化
items.title_en: Online LLM Personalization from Pairwise Preferences Across Users
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型可以用不同风格回答同一个问题，但用户偏好的风格是隐藏的，并且因用户和问题而异。论文研究推理阶段的个性化：从一个固定的提示词集合（每个代表一种人设）中在线选择，用户依次到来，每人提出一小段问题序列，系统对每个问题展示两个回答，并只观察一次成对选择。作者把这一交互形式化为上下文对决 bandit（contextual dueling bandit）问题的一个变体，学习者一开始对偏好毫无信息，需要在与用户的交互中逐步学习并提供个性化输出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models can answer the same question in different styles, but users' preferred styles are hidden and vary across users and questions. We study inference-time personalization through online selection from a fixed set of prompts, each representing a persona. Users arrive sequentially, each asks a short sequence of questions, and the system displays two responses per question and observes one pairwise choice. We formulate this interaction as a variant of the contextual dueling bandit problem in which the learner starts without preferen…
items.why_zh: 为无需微调的推理期 LLM 个性化提供了可学习的交互式框架与理论建模。
items.why_en: It provides a learnable, interaction-based framework for inference-time LLM personalization without fine-tuning.

items.title_zh: CÆNL：基于坍缩的主动神经学习与目标对齐的表示控制
items.title_en: C{\AE}NL: Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning with Objective-Aligned Representation Control
items.summary_zh: 主动学习会改变用于获取后续标签的表示。论文通过“基于坍缩的主动神经学习”（CÆNL）研究这种相互作用，将采集过程、动态坍缩正则化（DCR）及其系数策略分离开来。DCR 会对高于冻结参考值的归一化类内—类间散度残差施加惩罚，并配有独立的类分离保障机制。研究采用固定、调度式、确定性反馈与学习反馈等策略来施加该目标，并从理论上建立了散度不变性等性质。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Active learning changes the representations used to acquire subsequent labels. We study this interaction through Collapse-Based Active Neural Learning (C{\AE}NL), which separates acquisition, Dynamic Collapse Regularization (DCR), and its coefficient policy. DCR penalizes a normalized within-class to between-class scatter residual above a frozen reference, with a separate class-separation safeguard. Fixed, scheduled, deterministic-feedback, and learned-feedback policies apply this objective. The analysis establishes scatter invariances, condition…
items.why_zh: 揭示并控制了主动学习中表示退化（坍缩）与标签采集之间的耦合问题。
items.why_en: It addresses and controls the coupling between representation collapse and label acquisition in active learning.

items.title_zh: 面向差分隐私持续 LoRA 的稳定—可塑子空间构建
items.title_en: Stable-Plastic Subspace Construction for Differentially Private Continual LoRA
items.summary_zh: 持续学习（CL）让预训练模型依次适配多个任务，同时保留早前任务学到的知识。当任务数据涉及敏感信息时，差分隐私（DP）可提供记录级保护，但在隐私约束下同时维持适配能力与知识保留仍十分困难。论文在持续 LoRA 场景中研究该问题，观察到两点现象：隐私训练带来的遗忘主要发生在后续适配阶段，而非初始任务的学习阶段；对 LoRA 的两个因子联合加噪也会带来不利影响。基于这些观察，作者提出稳定—可塑子空间的构建方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.17904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continual learning (CL) adapts pretrained models to a sequence of tasks while retaining knowledge acquired from earlier tasks. When task data are sensitive, differential privacy (DP) provides record-level protection, but maintaining both adaptation and retention under privacy constraints remains challenging. We study this problem in continual low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and observe that: 1) private training increases forgetting primarily during subsequent adaptation rather than initial task acquisition; 2) jointly perturbing both LoRA factors intr…
items.why_zh: 在隐私约束的持续 LoRA 中定位了遗忘发生的关键阶段，并提出兼顾稳定性与可塑性的子空间方案。
items.why_en: It pinpoints when forgetting arises under private continual LoRA and proposes a subspace scheme balancing stability and plasticity.

items.title_zh: SoK：重新思考表格机器学习中的成员推断
items.title_en: SoK: Rethinking Membership Inference in Tabular Machine Learning
items.summary_zh: 成员推断攻击（MIA）目前是评估机器学习应用隐私性的主流手段，但仍有一些问题未被充分探讨，在表格数据方面尤为明显。已有评测大多聚焦高维数据集，中小规模数据集的隐私行为基本无人研究。本文提出了一个新的 MIA 分类体系，并对影响脆弱性的因素展开系统性研究，评估了四种不同的最新攻击方法。工作填补了表格机器学习隐私评测的空白，呼吁重新审视这类场景下的隐私评估方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are currently the dominant approach to evaluating privacy in machine learning applications. Despite their significance, several concerns remain unexplored, particularly with regard to tabular data. Existing evaluations focus predominantly on high-dimensional datasets, leaving the privacy behavior of small-to-medium datasets unexplored. In this paper, we present a new taxonomy for MIAs and conduct a comprehensive study of the factors influencing vulnerability. We evaluate four distinct state-of-the-art attacks a…
items.why_zh: 将成员推断评测扩展到被长期忽视的中小规模表格数据，推动更现实的隐私评估。
items.why_en: It extends membership inference evaluation to long-neglected small and medium tabular datasets, enabling more realistic privacy assessment.

items.title_zh: 理解并缓解大规模推荐系统训练不稳定性：级联视角
items.title_en: Understanding and Mitigating Training Instability in Large-Scale Recommender Systems: A Cascade Perspective
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文系统分析了大规模推荐系统在动态工业平台上的训练稳定性问题，例如日交互量达数十亿的短视频服务。用户数据分布的快速漂移与模型复杂度不断上升，常常触发一种“发散级联”：先出现梯度爆炸，再传播为权重爆炸，最终导致损失爆炸，即 G-W-L 级联，严重阻碍模型收敛与性能表现。论文对这一级联机制进行了系统分析，并探讨缓解思路，为工业级推荐模型的稳定训练提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.14394v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Training large-scale recommender systems on dynamic industrial platforms, such as Short-Form Video (SFV) services with billions of daily interactions, faces critical stability challenges. Rapid distribution shifts in user data and increasing model complexity frequently trigger a divergence cascade, typically initiating with gradient explosion, propagating to weight explosion, and culminating in loss explosion. This G-W-L cascade severely impedes model convergence and performance. This paper provides a systematic analysis of this G-W-L cascade w…
items.why_zh: 它把推荐系统训练崩溃总结为可识别的“梯度—权重—损失”级联机制，为工业级模型的稳定训练提供分析框架。
items.why_en: It characterizes recommender training collapse as an identifiable gradient-weight-loss cascade, offering a framework for stabilizing industrial-scale training.

items.title_zh: Sanzaru：认知与沟通不对称下的协议形成基准
items.title_en: Sanzaru: Benchmarking Protocol Formation under Epistemic & Communication Asymmetry
items.summary_zh: 语言模型能单独完成任务，并不意味着一个团队在信息与沟通不对等时也能完成，Sanzaru 基准正是为检验这一差距而设计。任务改编自 BombBanana 的协作拆弹谜题：任务信息与操作权限被分给三个智能体，其中一个听不见、一个说不了、一个看不见。该基准包含 7 个族共 120 个谜题实例，每个族针对一种特定的协调能力；作者在 1512 局互动中评测了 7 个模型，用以考察多智能体在不对称条件下的协议形成能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15163v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achi…
items.why_zh: 它把多智能体协作评估从“能力叠加”推进到信息与沟通受限条件下的协议形成，直指真实团队协作的难点。
items.why_en: It shifts multi-agent evaluation from summing individual ability to protocol formation under restricted information and communication, a core real-world teamwork challenge.

items.title_zh: 数据发布必须为离线策略评估保留什么
items.title_en: What a Data Release Must Preserve for Off-Policy Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 在离线策略评估中，如果合并了对特定策略价值或策略比较具有不同意义的决策时刻历史，即使动作与结果可观测、行为策略与目标策略已知，该评估也可能变得不可识别。论文刻画了必须保留的区分：识别成立当且仅当每条发布记录内部与动作相关的评估权重为常数，而最粗的精确发布方式就是按这些权重对历史分组。针对归一化结果，作者还给出了由发布所导致的最大锐利宽度界限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15283v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In off-policy evaluation, merging decision-time histories that matter differently for a specified policy value or comparison can make that evaluation unidentified, even with observed actions and outcomes and known behavior and target policies. We characterize which distinctions must be preserved: identification holds if and only if the action-specific evaluation weights are constant within each released record, and the coarsest exact release groups histories by these weights. For normalized outcomes, the largest sharp width induced by the relea…
items.why_zh: 它给出了数据发布粒度与离线策略评估可识别性之间的充要条件，直接影响隐私数据共享与策略评估的可靠性。
items.why_en: It gives a necessary-and-sufficient condition linking release granularity to off-policy evaluation identifiability, directly affecting privacy-aware data sharing and policy evaluation.

items.title_zh: 经典基线如何塑造拓扑优化中的机器学习加速宣称
items.title_en: How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization
items.summary_zh: 拓扑优化通过布置材料，使结构在给定载荷下抵抗变形；机器学习方法常宣称相对经典非学习优化有大幅加速。但论文指出，经典代码跑得慢，或学到的设计刚度不及经典结果，都会夸大这种加速。作者在同一台工作站上重跑八种已公开代码的方法，并重点研究两种：生成设计的扩散模型 Optimize Any Topology（OAT）与基于图的神经优化器。仅加速经典代码的有限元求解器，就明显缩小了这两种方法的加速幅度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16051v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Topology optimization places material so that a structure resists deformation under given loads. Machine-learning methods often report large speed-ups over classical, non-learned optimization, but a slow classical code or a less stiff learned design can exaggerate them. We re-ran released code for eight methods on one workstation and studied two in depth: Optimize Any Topology (OAT), a diffusion model that generates designs, and a graph-based neural optimizer. Speeding up only the classical code's finite-element solver cut these two methods' sp…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究报告的加速比高度依赖经典基线的实现效率与设计质量，呼吁更公平的对比基准。
items.why_en: It shows reported speed-ups depend heavily on the classical baseline's efficiency and design quality, arguing for fairer benchmarking.

items.title_zh: 具有推断遗憾保证的高斯过程赌博机探索策略
items.title_en: Exploration strategies for Gaussian process bandit optimization with inference regret guarantees
items.summary_zh: 现有贝叶斯优化（BO）的累积遗憾保证，未必能刻画算法最终输出结果的质量。在带噪声的评估场景下这一缺口尤为关键，因为目标往往只是返回一个高质量的推荐解。作者提出高效的探索策略，可嵌入任意 BO 流程：偶尔用一次探索查询替代采集查询。为验证该方法，他们对搜索空间上的高斯过程后验标准差给出上界，从而建立推断遗憾层面的理论保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16187v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing cumulative regret guarantees for Bayesian optimization (BO) do not necessarily characterize the quality of the algorithm's final output. This gap is critical under noisy evaluations, where the goal is to return a single high-quality recommendation. To address it, we introduce efficient exploration strategies that can be incorporated into any BO procedure by occasionally replacing the acquisition query with an exploration query. To validate this approach, we bound the Gaussian process posterior standard deviation over the search space v…
items.why_zh: 它把贝叶斯优化的理论保证从累积遗憾转向“最终推荐质量”，更贴近实际部署中的需求。
items.why_en: It shifts Bayesian optimization guarantees from cumulative regret toward final recommendation quality, matching practical deployment needs.

items.title_zh: 面向可验证奖励 LLM 强化学习的谱驱动自适应秩优化器
items.title_en: Spectral-Driven Adaptive-Rank Optimizer for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.summary_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）正在重塑大语言模型获取推理能力的方式，但目前所用的优化器大多沿用教师强制训练时代的做法。论文由此提出一个根本问题：RLVR 是否带来了不同的优化几何，从而需要不同的优化器？作者通过大语言模型梯度的谱结构研究发现，梯度能量会逐步集中到一个不断收缩的有效子空间中，这被认为是 RLVR 的特征。基于此，他们提出了谱驱动的自适应秩优化器。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is reshaping how large language models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities, yet the optimizers used remain largely inherited from teacher-forcing training. This raises a fundamental question: does RLVR induce a distinct optimization geometry that calls for a different optimizer? We investigate this question through the spectral structure of LLM gradients and find that gradient energy progressively concentrates into a shrinking effective subspace, which is characteristic of RLVR, as it is a…
items.why_zh: 它指出 RLVR 具有独特的优化几何，为改进大模型强化学习训练算法提供了新方向。
items.why_en: It argues RLVR has a distinct optimization geometry, pointing to new directions for improving LLM reinforcement-learning optimizers.

items.title_zh: 重复测量何时损害表格基础模型
items.title_en: When Repeated Measurements Hurt Tabular Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）在 IID 基准上表现领先，但它们如何应对在同一输入上反复出现的测量值？作者在六种 TFM 上开展合成与半合成实验，发现额外测量能改善已测输入处的预测，却会损害其他位置的预测。这种损害在低噪声时最为频繁，在若干模型中无关特征还会放大它，真实重复测量数据集也呈现类似模式。统计上，PFN 预训练所瞄准的 IID 规则把每次重复测量当作独立样本来处理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.16801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on IID benchmarks, but how do they respond to repeated measurements at the same inputs? Across six TFMs, synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments show that additional measurements can improve predictions at measured inputs while degrading them elsewhere. Harm is most frequent at low noise, and irrelevant features amplify it in several models; real repeated-measurement datasets show similar patterns. Statistically, the IID rule targeted by PFN pretraining treats each repeated…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了表格基础模型在存在重复测量时的系统性失效模式，提示现实表格数据与 IID 预训练假设之间的错配。
items.why_en: It exposes a systematic failure mode of tabular foundation models under repeated measurements, highlighting the mismatch between real tabular data and IID pretraining assumptions.

items.title_zh: 基于同态加密的金融交易图隐私保护 GNN 推理
items.title_en: Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference on Financial Transaction Graphs via Homomorphic Encryption
items.summary_zh: 金融网络中的反洗钱（AML）需要建模跨机构的交易模式，但严格的隐私法规使银行之间无法共享账户与交易特征。论文提出一套面向多银行场景的隐私保护图神经网络（GNN）推理框架：中央服务器以明文持有图的连接结构与预训练模型权重，各银行则将自己的交易特征加密保存，整个推理过程完全在加密特征上进行。这样既利用了跨行图结构信息，又避免暴露各行的敏感特征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.18054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) in financial networks requires modeling transaction patterns that span multiple institutions. In practice, however, banks cannot share account and transaction features due to strict privacy regulations. We propose a privacy-preserving graph neural network (GNN) inference framework tailored to this multi-bank setting. A central server holds the graph connectivity and pretrained model weights in plaintext, while each bank keeps its transaction features encrypted. Inference is then carried out entirely on encrypted feat…
items.why_zh: 它展示了在不共享原始特征的前提下联合进行跨行反洗钱图推理的可行路径。
items.why_en: It shows a viable path to joint cross-bank AML graph inference without sharing raw features.

items.title_zh: 通过 API 生成差分隐私合成数据（三）：用模拟器替代基础模型
items.title_en: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via APIs 3: Using Simulators Instead of Foundation Model
