items.summary_zh: 差分隐私（DP）合成数据让敏感数据集在提供强隐私保证的前提下仍可被使用。此前提出的 Private Evolution（PE）框架被视为利用基础模型推理 API 生成 DP 合成数据的有前景方案，但并非每个私有数据领域都能找到合适的基础模型。这篇论文指出，PE 的适用范围比以往认识更广，可以接入基础模型之外的 API——特别是最先进的非神经网络模拟器——从而在缺乏合适基础模型的领域也能生成 DP 合成数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.05505v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Differentially private (DP) synthetic data enables the use of sensitive datasets while providing strong privacy guarantees. Recently, Private Evolution (PE) has emerged as a promising framework for generating DP synthetic data using only inference APIs of foundation models. However, suitable foundation models are not always available for every private data domain. In this paper, we show that PE is more general than previously understood and can incorporate APIs beyond foundation models. In particular, we show that state-of-the-art non-neural-…
items.why_zh: 它拓宽了差分隐私合成数据生成的可选“数据源”，让没有合适基础模型的领域也能获得强隐私保证。
items.why_en: It broadens the sources available for DP synthetic data generation, enabling strong privacy guarantees in domains lacking suitable foundation models.

items.title_zh: 带对抗性上下文的约束型上下文赌博机
items.title_en: Constrained Contextual Bandits with Adversarial Contexts
items.summary_zh: 该研究考察对抗性上下文下的约束型上下文赌博机问题：每个动作都会带来随机奖励和随机成本，条件平均奖励与成本属于已知函数类，并通过在线回归预言机进行学习。其比较基准是一个平稳随机策略，要求在每一个观测到的上下文处期望成本非正。作者将 Foster 与 Rakhlin（2020）提出的经典 SquareCB 算法——把上下文赌博机归约为回归问题——推广到带约束的情形，并引入替代（surrogate）方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.06190v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study constrained contextual bandits with adversarial contexts, where each action yields a random reward and incurs a random cost. The conditional mean reward and cost belong to known function classes and are learned through online regression oracles. The benchmark is a stationary randomized policy whose expected cost is non-positive at every observed context. We extend the seminal $\mathsf{SquareCB}$ algorithm of Foster and Rakhlin (2020), which reduces the contextual bandits to a regression problem, to the constrained setting. A surrogat…
items.why_zh: 它把高效的回归式上下文赌博机算法扩展到需要满足成本约束的现实场景，具有理论与应用价值。
items.why_en: It extends an efficient regression-based contextual bandit algorithm to settings that must satisfy cost constraints, a common real-world requirement.

items.title_zh: 你真的需要更多数据吗？用 TabLens 重新思考标签稀缺表格分类中的 LLM 部署
items.title_en: Do You Even Need More Data? Rethinking LLM Deployment for Label-Scarce Tabular Classification with TabLens
items.summary_zh: 表格分类任务通常需要足够的标注数据；当标签稀缺时，从业者只能收集更多样本、把领域知识编码为特征，或接受更差的性能。大语言模型凭借预训练获得的知识提供了另一种选择，由此引出三个问题：零样本推理能否减少对标注数据的需求？更丰富的提示能否减少对更多样本的需求？编码的领域知识能否弥补数据缺失？论文提出 TabLens，在明确的实验条件下逐一回答这些问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.24417v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Every tabular classification task requires sufficient labeled data. When labels are scarce, practitioners can collect more examples, encode domain expertise into features, or accept lower performance. Large language models offer an alternative by leveraging knowledge acquired during pretraining. This raises three questions: (i) can zero-shot inference reduce the need for labeled data; (ii) can a richer prompt reduce the need for more examples; and (iii) can encoded domain knowledge compensate for missing data? To answer each under explicit, t…
items.why_zh: 它为“标签稀缺时该不该上大模型、怎么上”提供了可对照的实证依据，而非仅凭经验直觉。
items.why_en: It provides controlled empirical evidence on whether and how to deploy LLMs when labeled tabular data is scarce.

items.title_zh: 用梯度封印实现针对禁用能力获取的预防性 LLM 遗忘
items.title_en: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
items.summary_zh: 开放权重的大模型不仅作为固定产品发布，也被当作下游微调的基座，这种开放性带来了法律与伦理风险：用户可能通过微调注入非法知识或支撑有害操作。因此模型提供方需要一种发布前的防御手段，这引出了“预防性遗忘”问题。与移除固定模型中已有能力的回溯式遗忘不同，预防性遗忘旨在阻止模型在后续微调中获取这些能力，论文提出“梯度封印”方法应对这一挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.39866v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Open-weight LLMs are released not only as fixed products but also as substrates for downstream fine-tuning. This openness, however, creates legal and ethical risks because users may misuse fine-tuning to instill illicit knowledge or enable hostile operations. Model providers therefore need apre-release defense against such acquisition, motivating the problem of preemptive unlearning. Unlike retrospective unlearning, which removes capabilities already present in a fixed model, preemptive unlearning seeks to prevent their acquisition under unse…
items.why_zh: 它把模型安全防线从“事后删除”前移到“发布前预防”，对开放权重模型的安全治理意义重大。
items.why_en: It moves model safety from post-hoc removal to pre-release prevention, which matters greatly for governing open-weight models.

items.title_zh: 通过自适应获取与序列融合实现高效多模态推理
items.title_en: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
items.summary_zh: 多模态系统常常对全部可用输入都进行编码，即便其中一部分信息已足以完成预测。自适应获取可以利用逐步融合证据所得出的预测，决定下一个要编码的模态以及何时停止，从而降低开销。但序列融合会使预测依赖顺序，导致决策需要区分同一已获取集合下阶乘级数量的历史路径。为此作者提出 SemARC，将序列模态聚合器（SeMA）与自适应运行时控制器（ARC）结合起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07466v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and u…
items.why_zh: 它在不牺牲预测效果的前提下压缩多模态推理成本，直击多模态部署中的算力浪费问题。
items.why_en: It cuts multimodal inference cost without sacrificing accuracy, addressing a key source of waste in multimodal deployment.

items.title_zh: CityDeploy-Bench：面向多发射机网络部署的物理仿真空间集合规划基准
items.title_en: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
items.summary_zh: 在复杂的城市传播环境与全网干扰条件下，实现城市级无线网络部署的自动化仍很困难。论文提出 CityDeploy-Bench，把多发射机部署重新表述为统一射线追踪验证器下的“物理仿真空间集合规划”问题。该基准将效用表示与规划动态分离，从而能够在不同规划器之间，对直接标量奖励、关系模型以及高阶交互结构进行可控比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.11065v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier. The benchmark separates utility representation from planning dynamics, enabling controlled comparison between direct scalar rewards, relational models, and higher-order interaction structures across diverse planners. Our experiments reveal a…
items.why_zh: 它为城市级无线部署这一高维规划难题提供了统一的物理可验证评测标准。
items.why_en: It provides a unified, physically verifiable benchmark for a high-dimensional urban wireless deployment planning problem.

items.title_zh: 带宽预算下的联邦语言模型：蒸馏率与保形覆盖
items.title_en: Federated Language Models Under Bandwidth Budgets: Distillation Rates and Conformal Coverage
items.summary_zh: 医院、企业和研究联盟希望在数据不出本地的前提下，通过卫星链路等有限带宽通道共同训练并查询语言模型。对各地模型参数做平均会使每条消息的大小随模型规模增长，并要求统一架构；交换预测结果的方法可规避这两点限制，但此前尚无研究界定压缩这些预测所带来的代价。论文提出两种方法，对每条消息都以一定压缩率进行压缩，并给出相应的保形覆盖分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.09986v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hospitals, companies, and research consortia want language models that learn from, and answer questions over, data that must stay where it is held, over links with limited bandwidth, such as the satellite links of remote clinics and ships. Averaging the sites' model parameters makes each message grow with the model and requires one shared architecture; methods that exchange predictions avoid both limits, but, to our knowledge, none bounds what compressing those predictions costs. We introduce two methods that compress every message at a…
items.why_zh: 它首次量化了联邦语言模型中压缩预测的代价，为带宽受限场景下的隐私保护协作提供了理论依据。
items.why_en: It quantifies the cost of compressing exchanged predictions in federated language models, offering theory for privacy-preserving collaboration under bandwidth limits.

items.title_zh: 神经状态空间模型的在线学习
items.title_en: Online learning of neural state-space models
items.summary_zh: 基于深度学习的非线性系统辨识近期取得进展，其中基于编码器的神经状态空间（ANN-SS）模型通过从历史输入输出数据估计初始模型状态，在离线场景下达到领先性能。这类方法通常用于基于多重打靶（multiple shooting）的离线辨识，而其在线学习仍基本未被探索。本文提出了一套批处理式学习流程，以及针对子空间编码器模型的直接递推辨识算法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.17614v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent advances in deep-learning-based nonlinear system identification have led to encoder-based estimation of neural state-space (ANN-SS) models that achieve state-of-the-art performance in offline settings by estimating initial model states from past input-output data. These methods are typically used in multiple-shooting-based offline identification, and online learning of these models remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a batch-wise learning pipeline and a direct recursive identification algorithm for subspace encoder-ba…
items.why_zh: 它把表现优异的神经状态空间辨识方法从离线推广到在线场景，对实时系统建模与控制很关键。
items.why_en: It extends strong neural state-space identification from offline to online settings, which is key for real-time modeling and control.

items.title_zh: NeuroRule：用规则集演化让黑盒神经网络变得可解释
items.title_en: NeuroRule: Making Black-Box Neural Networks Explainable through Rule-set Evolution
items.summary_zh: 高容量神经网络在各类分类任务上表现优异，却往往以黑盒方式运行，缺乏关键决策所需的透明度，由此形成性能与可解释性之间的长期取舍。为此，论文提出 NeuroRule 知识蒸馏框架，可从神经网络模型中提炼出可解释的规则集。该框架改造了 EVOTER 规则集演化基础设施，用于生成人类可读的规则表示，从而在保留模型预测能力的同时提升决策透明度。论文以 arXiv 预印本形式发布（编号 arXiv:2609.26841v2，属 replace-cross 更新）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26841v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-capacity neural network models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse classification tasks, yet they frequently operate as black-box models, lacking the transparency necessary for critical decision-making. Such opacity creates a persistent trade-off between performance and explainability. This paper proposes a solution to address this gap: the NeuroRule knowledge distillation framework that results in explainable rule-sets from neural network models. NeuroRule adapts the EVOTER rule-set evolution infrastructure t…
items.why_zh: 它尝试在不让模型性能大幅退化的前提下，把黑盒神经网络转化为人类可读的规则，为高风险场景的可解释决策提供一条可行路径。
items.why_en: It offers a way to turn opaque neural networks into human-readable rules, potentially enabling trustworthy decisions in high-stakes applications.

items.title_zh: 视频生成的“黄金锚点”
items.title_en: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
items.summary_zh: 视频生成正被用于虚拟化身、AI 电影制作、交互式游戏引擎与“世界模型”等场景。当前主流系统主要通过图生视频（I2V）实现可控性：注入的一张锚点图像决定了生成视频的身份、构图与风格，而在现代流程中，这张锚点通常由文生图（T2I）模型合成。论文由此提出一个此前被普遍忽视的问题：直接来自 T2I 模型的图像，是否真的是最佳的锚点选择。该工作以 arXiv 预印本形式发布（编号 arXiv:2610.13217v2，属 replace-cross 更新）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.13217v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly…
items.why_zh: 锚点图像的质量与来源直接决定图生视频的可控性和成品效果，重新审视这一环节有望提升整个视频生成流程的可靠性。
items.why_en: Since the anchor image governs controllability in image-to-video generation, rethinking how it is produced could improve the whole video-generation pipeline.

items.title_zh: 彭博社报告：云游戏与 AI 或将终结传统游戏主机
items.title_en: Bloomberg: Cloud Gaming and AI Could Eventually End Traditional Consoles
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，彭博社今天（14 日）发布的《深度分析：云游戏与 AI 或最终终结游戏主机》行业研究报告预测，到 2035 年，云游戏市场规模将达到 380 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,547.91 亿元人民币） 。随着云游戏日益普及，传统游戏主机可能最终 失去自身在大众消费市场的地位 。 报告指出，AI 将使游戏越来越复杂，对硬件性能的要求也会不断提高。相比每隔几年推出一代性能更强的新主机，利用数据中心运行游戏，再通过互联网将画面传输给玩家，能够更有效地满足需求。 其中，任天堂在云游戏领域的布局相对有限，一直将其放在公司战略的次要位置，因此可能难以适应这一转变。索尼集团的处境则相对有利，旗下 PlayStation Plus 服务体系更加成熟，还拥有支持远程游玩的 PlayStation Portal。 微软、英伟达和腾讯也有望凭借云基础设施方面的投资获益。报告预计，微软 XBOX 云游戏将维持约 40% 的市场份额，截至 9 月的季度累计云游戏时长估计达到 2.2 亿小时。 英伟达凭借需求旺盛的 GPU，在 GeForce NOW 云游戏服务方面具有技术优势；腾讯则被认为在中国云游戏市场拥有领先的技术实力。 负责该报告的彭博行业研究分析师内森 · 奈杜认为，当今 AI 数据中心服务需求激增，推高了算力价格。预计到本世纪 20 年代末，随着大量数据中心…
items.summary_en: A Bloomberg Intelligence report predicts the cloud gaming market will reach $38 billion by 2035, saying AI-driven complexity in games could erode the traditional console's place in the mass market. It sees Sony as relatively well positioned thanks to PlayStation Plus and PlayStation Portal, while Nintendo's limited cloud push may leave it exposed. Microsoft, Nvidia and Tencent are also expected to benefit from cloud infrastructure investments, with Xbox cloud gaming projected to hold roughly 40% share.
items.why_zh: 若云游戏与 AI 真能替代主机硬件，将重塑索尼、任天堂、微软及云厂商在数千亿美元游戏市场中的竞争格局。
items.why_en: If cloud gaming and AI really displace console hardware, it would reshape competition among Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft and cloud providers in a market worth tens of billions of dollars.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek将完成1000亿元融资
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Set to Complete 10 Billion Yuan Financing
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek将完成1000亿元融资 新浪网
items.summary_en: According to Sina, DeepSeek is reportedly set to complete a financing round of 100 billion yuan (about 10 billion yuan-denominated scale as reported). Details such as investors and use of proceeds were not disclosed, and the report awaits official confirmation.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这将是 AI 大模型领域罕见的大规模融资，可能显著影响 DeepSeek 的算力储备与后续模型研发节奏。
items.why_en: If confirmed, a financing of this scale would be unusually large for the AI model sector and could materially shape DeepSeek's compute and research roadmap.

items.title_zh: 阶跃星辰发布StepX Neo智能体手机，售价3999元并推出百亿Token计划
items.title_en: StepFun Launches StepX Neo Agent Phone at 3,999 Yuan, With 10-Billion-Token Plan
items.summary_zh: 阶跃星辰发布StepX Neo智能体手机，售价3999元并推出百亿Token计划 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Chinese AI model company StepFun has launched the StepX Neo, a phone priced at 3,999 yuan that it bills as an agent-centric device, alongside a plan offering 10 billion tokens. The move marks another attempt by an AI model developer to extend into hardware. Hardware specs, availability and the token plan's detailed terms were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 大模型公司亲自下场做“智能体手机”，是 AI 从软件走向终端入口、抢占用户第一触点的标志性尝试。
items.why_en: A model developer building its own agent phone shows AI firms trying to own the device-level entry point to users, not just the software layer.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机助手陆续放开第三方应用操作权限 推出屏幕自动化声明协议
items.title_en: Doubao Phone Assistant Opens Third-Party App Controls, Launches Screen Automation Protocol
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机助手陆续放开第三方应用操作权限 推出屏幕自动化声明协议 观点网
items.summary_en: Doubao's phone assistant is gradually opening up permissions to operate third-party apps and has introduced a screen-automation declaration protocol to govern such behavior. The step moves mobile AI agents from conversation toward actually performing tasks across apps, while addressing privacy and compliance concerns. The scope of supported apps and rollout pace remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: 跨应用代操作是手机 AI 助手价值兑现的关键，但权限与隐私边界也决定其能否被用户和应用方接受。
items.why_en: Cross-app automation is what makes a phone AI assistant genuinely useful, but permission and privacy rules will decide whether users and app makers accept it.

items.title_zh: 好现产品升级｜从GEO智能体到AI渠道经营系统，全新上线豆包渠道增长服务
items.title_en: Haoxian Upgrades From GEO Agent to AI Channel Management System, Adds Doubao Growth Service
items.summary_zh: 好现产品升级｜从GEO智能体到AI渠道经营系统，全新上线豆包渠道增长服务 电商派
items.summary_en: Haoxian has upgraded its product line, expanding from a GEO (generative engine optimization) agent into an AI channel management system and launching a new Doubao channel growth service. The shift moves it from a single-purpose optimization tool toward a broader channel operations platform. Pricing and feature specifics were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 生成式搜索与 AI 渠道正在成为新的流量入口，商家工具随之从 SEO/GEO 单点优化转向渠道经营体系。
items.why_en: Generative search and AI channels are becoming new traffic gateways, pushing merchant tools from single-point SEO/GEO optimization toward full channel operations.

items.title_zh: 消息称具身智能独角兽公司智元启动新一轮融资，估值约 500 亿元
items.title_en: Agibot Starts New Funding Round of 1-1.5 Billion Yuan at About 50 Billion Yuan Valuation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，据财经杂志 10 月 13 日报道，具身智能独角兽公司智元创新近期启动了新一轮融资， 融资额约 10 亿元 —15 亿元 ，本轮融资已接近收尾，最新估值约 500 亿元。 报道提到，根据港交所的相关要求，上市申请公司如果在递表后、上市前完成新融资，除非获得特殊豁免，上市申请公司需要等到融资完成后满 120 日，才可挂牌交易。投资人称， 新一轮融资意味着智元在今年内无法完成 IPO（首次公开募股） 。 智元是一家以具身智能为核心技术方向的通用 AI 机器人公司，于 2023 年成立。9 月 24 日， 智元第 2 万台具身智能机器人宣布下线 ，刷新全球量产纪录。 根据 Counterpoint Research 发布的人形机器人研究报告 ，2026 年上半年全球人形机器人出货量突破 2.2 万台，同比增长近 300%，保持强劲增长势头。 出货量方面， 智元 AGIBOT 以 9,700 台的出货量位居全球第一，市场份额超 43% ，随后依次是宇树机器人（Unitree）、银河通用机器人（Galbot）、优必选（UBTECH）和乐聚机器人（Leju Robotics），前五名厂商均为中国厂商，合计占据总出货量的 86%。
items.summary_en: Chinese embodied-AI unicorn Agibot has launched a new funding round of roughly 1-1.5 billion yuan at a valuation of about 50 billion yuan, according to Caijing, with the round nearing completion. Investors say Hong Kong listing rules requiring a 120-day gap after a pre-IPO financing mean an IPO this year is now unlikely. The company, founded in 2023, announced its 20,000th robot rolled off the line on Sept. 24, and Counterpoint data puts it first globally in humanoid robot shipments with 9,700 units and over 43% share.
items.why_zh: 智元的高估值与融资节奏既反映具身智能赛道热度，也显示资本规则正在影响这类公司的上市时间表。
items.why_en: Agibot's high valuation and funding timing show both the heat in embodied AI and how capital-market rules can reshape a startup's IPO schedule.

items.title_zh: 坐无后视镜的特斯拉 Cybercab 心里发慌？未来乘客行程中可随时查看侧、后摄像头画面
items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab Will Let Riders View Side and Rear Camera Feeds Anytime
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，乘坐特斯拉无人驾驶出租车 Cybercab 的乘客很快将能在行程中的任意时刻查看车辆侧方与后方画面。特斯拉爱好者丹 · 伯克兰（Dan Burkland）在乘坐这款专为自动驾驶打造的机器人出租车之后，于 X 平台称赞了 Cybercab 的软件体验，并提议特斯拉允许乘客“按需调取车尾与后视镜摄像头画面”，他补充说，“这个功能尤其能提升乘坐安全感。” 特斯拉 UI 软件工程师埃文（Evan）简单回复称：“正在开发中。”他并未说明该功能的上线时间。 Cybercab 没有外后视镜，也没有车内后视镜，所以乘客在乘车途中无法看到车辆后方与两侧环境。特斯拉的机器人出租车系统依靠 8 颗外置摄像头采集视频，但乘客目前无法查看这些画面。 现阶段，摄像头画面只会在抵达目的地时才显示。屏幕会弹出“请安全下车”提示，并并排展示左侧补盲摄像头、车尾摄像头与右侧补盲摄像头的画面，方便乘客在开门下车前观察车流、骑行者或行人。该界面还会提醒乘客带走随身物品。 但乘客在行驶途中无法主动调出这些画面。这项即将推出的功能，将支持乘客随时调取同样的摄像头画面，有助于初次乘坐的用户适应这款没有驾驶员、方向盘、刹车踏板以及传统后视镜的车辆。 按需调取摄像头画面功能，可能正是 Cybercab 首席工程师埃里克 · 厄利（Eric Earley）此前在 X Takeover 活动上透露的“…
items.summary_en: Tesla Cybercab passengers will soon be able to pull up the vehicle's side and rear camera feeds at any point during a ride, a Tesla UI engineer said the feature is 'in development' after a rider suggested it on X. The robotaxi has no mirrors and relies on eight external cameras, whose feeds currently appear only on arrival alongside a safe-exit prompt. The change is meant to help riders feel safer and adapt to a car with no driver, steering wheel, pedals or mirrors.
items.why_zh: 在取消后视镜的无人驾驶车里给乘客实时视野，是提升无人出租车信任度与乘坐体验的关键细节。
items.why_en: Giving riders live visibility in a mirrorless robotaxi is a small but crucial step for building trust in driverless ride services.

items.title_zh: SoftBank junk bond sale raises stakes for CEO Son's all-in AI bet
items.title_en: SoftBank Junk Bond Sale Raises Stakes for CEO Son's All-In AI Bet
items.summary_zh: SoftBank junk bond sale raises stakes for CEO Son's all-in AI bet Reuters
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that SoftBank has sold junk-rated bonds, a move that raises the stakes in CEO Masayoshi Son's all-in bet on AI. The high-yield issuance means the group is again funding aggressive AI investments with debt at a higher cost of capital. Bond size, pricing and use of proceeds were not detailed.
items.why_zh: 以高成本债务支撑 AI 豪赌，放大了软银的财务杠杆，也折射出当前 AI 基础设施投资的资金饥渴程度。
items.why_en: Funding an AI gamble with costly debt amplifies SoftBank's leverage and highlights how capital-hungry today's AI infrastructure race has become.

items.title_zh: OpenAI员工因涉嫌在会议室安装录音设备被捕
items.title_en: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
items.summary_zh: OpenAI一名工程师被捕，公司称在其办公室内发现一枚“精密的录音设备”。该员工被确认为35岁的沙特籍人士Abdulrahman Alfozan。美国司法部新闻稿称，他被控使用或试图使用设备拦截口头通信。OpenAI表示，公司利用自身AI模型分析该设备并追溯来源，确认是一名特定员工在数日前安放。此事凸显AI公司内部安全、敏感技术保护和商业机密风险。
items.summary_en: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national. Alfozan is charged with using or endeavoring to use a device to intercept oral communications, according to a press release from the Department of Justice . OpenAI's post about the incident says it used its AI models to "understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier." As noted by the DOJ, OpenAI found the de…
items.why_zh: 涉及头部AI公司的内部安全与商业机密，且OpenAI用AI模型协助调查，凸显AI安全治理的双刃剑。
items.why_en: It highlights internal security and trade-secret risks at a leading AI company, with OpenAI using its own AI models in the investigation.

items.title_zh: 苹果推出智能家居中枢，Anthropic就联网家庭AI风险发出警告
items.title_en: Apple launches hub as Anthropic issues connected home AI risk warning
items.summary_zh: 据报道，苹果推出新的智能家居中枢产品，与此同时，Anthropic针对联网家庭场景中的AI风险发出警告。报道来自Insurance Business，但摘要未提供更多产品细节或警告的具体内容。事件反映智能家居AI加速普及之际，隐私、安全与保险责任等风险正受到更多关注。
items.summary_en: Apple launches hub as Anthropic issues connected home AI risk warning Insurance Business
items.why_zh: 智能家居AI快速落地，联网家庭中的安全与责任风险正成为监管和保险业关注焦点。
items.why_en: As AI moves into connected homes, security and liability risks are becoming a key concern for regulators and insurers.

items.title_zh: Shopify向更多AI代理开放商品目录
items.title_en: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
items.summary_zh: Shopify宣布，将允许购物者配置AI代理代其购买商品，并向更多AI代理开放其目录中超过10亿件商品。该目录既包含Shopify店铺内的商品，也包含店铺外的商品。此举是Shopify推进“代理式电商”雄心的最新一步，此前在9月已有相关动作，但摘要未展开具体内容。
items.summary_en: CANADA - 2025/07/20: In this photo illustration, the Shopify logo is seen displayed on a smartphone screen. (Photo Illustration by Thomas Fuller/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images) More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company's agentic commerce ambitions. Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September,…
items.why_zh: 电商平台加速拥抱AI代理购物，可能改变在线购物、支付和商家流量分配方式。
items.why_en: E-commerce platforms embracing AI-agent shopping could reshape online purchasing, payments and merchant traffic.

items.title_zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普发起全国性“超级智能”挑战，面向K-12学生
items.title_en: Melania Trump launches nationwide 'Super Intelligence' challenge for K-12 students
items.summary_zh: 据WCHS报道，梅拉尼娅·特朗普发起了一项名为“超级智能”的全国性挑战，面向K-12（幼儿园至高中）学生。该挑战旨在鼓励中小学生参与人工智能相关议题，但具体形式和规则尚未在报道摘要中详细说明。目前尚不清楚挑战的具体内容、时间表或奖励设置。此举可能推动AI教育在基础教育阶段的普及，并引发对青少年AI素养的关注。该挑战可能成为美国K-12 AI教育的重要推动力。
items.summary_en: Melania Trump launches nationwide 'Super Intelligence' challenge for K-12 students WCHS
items.why_zh: 前第一夫人推动K-12 AI教育，可能影响美国青少年科技素养培养。
items.why_en: The former First Lady's push for K-12 AI education could influence youth tech literacy in the U.S.

items.title_zh: 我不怀念Ray-Ban Meta音频眼镜的摄像头
items.title_en: I don’t miss the camera on the Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses
items.summary_zh: 作者分享使用Ray-Ban Meta Audio眼镜（无摄像头版本）的日常体验：跑步时听歌、在咖啡馆点单、公园长椅读书、与朋友通话，并向眼镜询问日程安排。AI语音回应称未连接Google Calendar（实际已连接），随后作者让它播放欢快歌曲，它选了Kendrick Lamar的歌曲。文章认为音频功能已足够实用，摄像头并非必需。这或许表明智能眼镜的音频交互正成为核心卖点。作者在多个场景中依赖语音助手，尽管偶有失误。
items.summary_en: The other day I whizzed past several people while running in the park, my playlist blasting at full volume. The next morning, I smiled at a barista while ordering a caramel apple-flavored matcha latte. Afterward, I sat on a park bench reading a book, called up a pal to chat about her recent trip to Prague, and then asked my Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses what meetings were coming up on my calendar. The chipper AI voice said I hadn't connected my Google Calendar yet (I had) and asked if I would like help connecting. I sighed and then asked it to play an upbeat song. items.why_zh: 展示智能眼镜音频功能的实用性，可能影响未来产品设计方向。
items.why_en: It shows that audio features alone can make smart glasses useful, potentially shaping future product design.

items.title_zh: 21Shares在欧洲推出首个Anthropic ETP，抢在其IPO之前
items.title_en: 21shares Launches First Anthropic ETP in Europe Ahead of Its IPO
items.summary_zh: 21Shares在欧洲推出了首个与Anthropic相关的交易所交易产品（ETP），此时正值Anthropic可能进行首次公开募股（IPO）之前。该ETP为欧洲投资者提供了接触这家AI公司的新渠道。此举可能预示着Anthropic的上市进程正在推进，同时也反映出市场对AI公司投资工具的强烈需求。ETP通常追踪资产价格，允许投资者在不直接持股的情况下获得敞口。该产品的具体结构和费用尚未在报道中披露。
items.summary_en: 21shares Launches First Anthropic ETP in Europe Ahead of Its IPO Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 首个Anthropic ETP为投资者提供IPO前敞口，反映AI投资工具需求上升。
items.why_en: The first Anthropic ETP gives investors pre-IPO exposure, reflecting rising demand for AI investment tools.

items.title_zh: Facebook允许用户用AI自定义信息流算法
items.title_en: Facebook will let you customize your feed algorithm using AI
items.summary_zh: Meta 为 Facebook 推出名为“Your Algorithm”的新功能，允许用户直接添加和管理想在信息流及 Facebook Reels 中看到的话题。用户对各类话题点击“感兴趣”或“不感兴趣”后，Meta 表示推荐结果会“立即响应”调整。该功能今年早些时候已率先登陆 Instagram，Meta 还在 Threads 上推出了类似的“Dear Algo”功能。Facebook 用户可通过“Your Algorithm”入口，或从单条帖子的三点菜单中选择“感兴趣”/“不感兴趣”。
items.summary_en: Facebook's new "Your Algorithm" feature will let you directly add and manage topics you want to see in your feed and Facebook Reels. Meta says your recommendations "respond right away" after you make updates using the new feature by hitting "interested" or "not interested" for different topics. Your Algorithm previously launched on Instagram earlier this year, and Meta also launched a similar "Dear Algo" feature on Threads. Facebook users will be able to access Your Algorithm or select "interested" or "not interested" from the three dots menu on individual posts. The "interested" and "not inte…
items.why_zh: 让用户直接干预推荐算法，是平台在算法透明度与用户控制权压力下的一次重要产品调整。
items.why_en: Giving users direct control over recommendation algorithms marks a notable product shift amid pressure for algorithmic transparency and user agency.

items.title_zh: Google让发布“氛围编程”应用更简单
items.title_en: Google makes it easier to launch your vibe-coded apps
items.summary_zh: Google 宣布在美国推出一项新功能，让用户可以直接通过 Play Store 发布用 AI Studio“氛围编程”的个人应用，无需再将手机连接电脑来安装。Google 今年 5 月首次推出为 Android 打造个人应用的能力。现在这些自定义应用可在 Google Play 中启动，但公司强调它们将保持“安全、私密，并与公开商店目录分开”。用户还可使用标准 Google 账户来发布这些应用。
items.summary_en: The next time you vibe-code a custom app with Google's AI Studio, you won't have to connect your phone to a computer to install it. On Tuesday, Google announced a new feature in the US that will allow you to launch personal apps directly through the Play Store. Google first launched the ability to vibe-code personal Android apps in May. Even though you can now launch your custom apps in Google Play, the company notes it will continue to keep them "secure, private, and separate from the public store catalog." You can also launch them using a standard Google account, and the company will soon ad…
items.why_zh: 降低个人 AI 生成应用的发布门槛，可能推动更多非开发者把创意快速变成可安装的 Android 应用。
items.why_en: Lowering the barrier to publishing AI-generated personal apps could accelerate app creation by non-developers and expand Google's AI-assisted development ecosystem.

items.title_zh: Google 面向开发者与企业发布旗舰 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_en: Google launches flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon for developers, businesses
items.summary_zh: 谷歌正式发布旗舰 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon，面向开发者与企业用户提供。该模型被定位为谷歌在前沿 AI 竞赛中的主力产品，主打对企业级复杂工作流的支持。此前谷歌一度被视为在这一轮前沿模型竞争中处于观望状态，此次发布标志着其重新进入第一梯队竞争。已知信息中尚未披露该模型的具体定价、开放渠道与详细性能指标。
items.summary_en: Google launches flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon for developers, businesses Reuters
items.why_zh: 谷歌以旗舰模型重返前沿竞争，将直接影响企业级 AI 市场的格局与客户选型。
items.why_en: Google's flagship release reshapes competition and customer choices in the enterprise AI market.
